# Welcome Llama 3 - Meta’s new open LLM

## Introduction

Meta’s Llama 3, the next iteration of the open-access Llama family, is now released and available at Hugging Face. It's great to see Meta continuing its commitment to open AI, and we’re excited to fully support the launch with comprehensive integration in the Hugging Face ecosystem.

Llama 3 comes in two sizes: 8B for efficient deployment and development on consumer-size GPU, and 70B for large-scale AI native applications. Both come in base and instruction-tuned variants. In addition to the 4 models, a new version of Llama Guard was fine-tuned on Llama 3 8B and is released as Llama Guard 2 (safety fine-tune).

We’ve collaborated with Meta to ensure the best integration into the Hugging Face ecosystem. You can find all 5 open-access models (2 base models, 2 fine-tuned & Llama Guard) on the Hub. Among the features and integrations being released, we have:

- Models on the Hub, with their model cards and licenses
- 🤗 Transformers integration
- Hugging Chat integration for Meta Llama 3 70b
- Inference Integration into Inference Endpoints, Google Cloud & Amazon SageMaker
- An example of fine-tuning Llama 3 8B on a single GPU with 🤗 TRL

## Table of contents

## What’s new with Llama 3?

The Llama 3 release introduces 4 new open LLM models by Meta based on the Llama 2 architecture. They come in two sizes: 8B and 70B parameters, each with base (pre-trained) and instruct-tuned versions. All the variants can be run on various types of consumer hardware and have a context length of 8K tokens.

- Meta-Llama-3-8b: Base 8B model
- Meta-Llama-3-8b-instruct: Instruct fine-tuned version of the base 8b model
- Meta-Llama-3-70b: Base 70B model
- Meta-Llama-3-70b-instruct: Instruct fine-tuned version of the base 70b model

In addition to these 4 base models, Llama Guard 2 was also released. Fine-tuned on Llama 3 8B, it’s the latest iteration in the Llama Guard family. Llama Guard 2, built for production use cases, is designed to classify LLM inputs (prompts) as well as LLM responses in order to detect content that would be considered unsafe in a risk taxonomy.

A big change in Llama 3 compared to Llama 2 is the use of a new tokenizer that expands the vocabulary size to 128,256 (from 32K tokens in the previous version). This larger vocabulary can encode text more efficiently (both for input and output) and potentially yield stronger multilingualism. This comes at a cost, though: the embedding input and output matrices are larger, which accounts for a good portion of the parameter count increase of the small model: it goes from 7B in Llama 2 to 8B in Llama 3. In addition, the 8B version of the model now uses Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), which is an efficient representation that should help with longer contexts.

The Llama 3 models were trained ~8x more data on over 15 trillion tokens on a new mix of publicly available online data on two clusters with 24,000 GPUs. We don’t know the exact details of the training mix, and we can only guess that bigger and more careful data curation was a big factor in the improved performance. Llama 3 Instruct has been optimized for dialogue applications and was trained on over 10 Million human-annotated data samples with combination of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), rejection sampling, proximal policy optimization (PPO), and direct policy optimization (DPO).

Regarding the licensing terms, Llama 3 comes with a permissive license that allows redistribution, fine-tuning, and derivative works. The requirement for explicit attribution is new in the Llama 3 license and was not present in Llama 2. Derived models, for instance, need to include "Llama 3" at the beginning of their name, and you also need to mention "Built with Meta Llama 3" in derivative works or services. For full details, please make sure to read the official license.

## Llama 3 evaluation

Here, you can see a list of models and their Open LLM Leaderboard scores. This is not a comprehensive list and we encourage you to look at the full leaderboard. Note that the LLM Leaderboard is specially useful to evaluate pre-trained models, as there are other benchmarks specific to conversational models.

Model | License | Pretraining length [tokens] | Leaderboard score 
---|---|---|---
MPT-7B | Apache 2.0 | 1,000B | 5.98 
Falcon-7B | Apache 2.0 | 1,500B | 5.1 
Llama-2-7B | Llama 2 license | 2T | 8.72 
Qwen 2 7B | Apache 2.0 | ? | 23.66 
Llama-3-8B | Llama 3 license | 15T | 13.41 
Llama-2-13B | Llama 2 license | 2T | 10.99 
Falcon-40B | Apache 2.0 | 1,000B | 11.33 
Falcon-40B | Apache 2.0 | 1,000B | 11.33 
Llama-2-70B | Llama 2 license | 2T | 18.25 
Llama-3-70B | Llama 3 license | 15T | 26.37 
Mixtral 8x22B | Apache 2 | ? | 25.49 

## How to prompt Llama 3

The base models have no prompt format. Like other base models, they can be used to continue an input sequence with a plausible continuation or for zero-shot/few-shot inference. They are also a great foundation for fine-tuning your own use cases. The Instruct versions use the following conversation structure:
<|begin_of_text|><|start_header_id|>system<|end_header_id|>

{{ system_prompt }}<|eot_id|><|start_header_id|>user<|end_header_id|>

{{ user_msg_1 }}<|eot_id|><|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>

{{ model_answer_1 }}<|eot_id|>

This format has to be exactly reproduced for effective use. We’ll later show how easy it is to reproduce the instruct prompt with the chat template available intransformers.

## Demo

You can chat with the Llama 3 70B instruct on Hugging Chat! Check out the link here: https://huggingface.co/chat/models/meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-70B-instruct

## Using 🤗 Transformers

With Transformers release 4.40, you can use Llama 3 and leverage all the tools within the Hugging Face ecosystem, such as:

- training and inference scripts and examples
- safe file format (safetensors)
- integrations with tools such as bitsandbytes (4-bit quantization), PEFT (parameter efficient fine-tuning), and Flash Attention 2
- utilities and helpers to run generation with the model
- mechanisms to export the models to deploy

In addition, Llama 3 models are compatible withtorch.compile() with CUDA graphs, giving them a ~4x speedup at inference time!

To use Llama 3 models with transformers, make sure to install a recent version oftransformers:
pip install --upgrade transformers

The following snippet shows how to useLlama-3-8b-instruct with transformers. It requires about 16 GB of RAM, which includes consumer GPUs such as 3090 or 4090.
from transformers import pipeline
import torch

model_id = "meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct"

pipe = pipeline(
    "text-generation",
    model=model_id,
    model_kwargs={"torch_dtype": torch.bfloat16},
    device="cuda",
)

messages = [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a pirate chatbot who always responds in pirate speak!"},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Who are you?"},
]

terminators = [
    pipe.tokenizer.eos_token_id,
    pipe.tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids("<|eot_id|>")
]

outputs = pipe(
    messages,
    max_new_tokens=256,
    eos_token_id=terminators,
    do_sample=True,
    temperature=0.6,
    top_p=0.9,
)
assistant_response = outputs[0]["generated_text"][-1]["content"]
print(assistant_response)

Arrrr, me hearty! Me name be Captain Chat, the scurviest pirate chatbot to ever sail the Seven Seas! Me be here to swab the decks o' yer mind with me trusty responses, savvy? I be ready to hoist the Jolly Roger and set sail fer a swashbucklin' good time, matey! So, what be bringin' ye to these fair waters?

A couple of details:

- We loaded the model inbfloat16. This is the type used by the original checkpoint published by Meta, so it’s the recommended way to run to ensure the best precision or to conduct evaluations. For real world use, it’s also safe to use float16, which may be faster depending on your hardware.
- Assistant responses may end with the special token<|eot_id|>, but we must also stop generation if the regular EOS token is found. We can stop generation early by providing a list of terminators in the eos_token_id parameter.
- We used the default sampling parameters (temperature and top_p) taken from the original meta codebase. We haven’t had time to conduct extensive tests yet, feel free to explore!

You can also automatically quantize the model, loading it in 8-bit or even 4-bit mode. 4-bit loading takes about 7 GB of memory to run, making it compatible with a lot of consumer cards and all the GPUs in Google Colab. This is how you’d load the generation pipeline in 4-bit:
pipeline = transformers.pipeline(
    "text-generation",
    model=model_id,
    model_kwargs={
        "torch_dtype": torch.float16,
        "quantization_config": {"load_in_4bit": True},
        "low_cpu_mem_usage": True,
    },
)

For more details on using the models with transformers, please check the model cards.

## Inference Integrations

In this section, we’ll go through different approaches to running inference of the Llama 3 models. Before using these models, make sure you have requested access to one of the models in the official Meta Llama 3 repositories.

### Integration with Inference Endpoints

You can deploy Llama 3 on Hugging Face's Inference Endpoints, which uses Text Generation Inference as the backend. Text Generation Inference is a production-ready inference container developed by Hugging Face to enable easy deployment of large language models. It has features such as continuous batching, token streaming, tensor parallelism for fast inference on multiple GPUs, and production-ready logging and tracing.

To deploy Llama 3, go to the model page and click on the Deploy -> Inference Endpoints widget. You can learn more about Deploying LLMs with Hugging Face Inference Endpoints in a previous blog post. Inference Endpoints supports Messages API through Text Generation Inference, which allows you to switch from another closed model to an open one by simply changing the URL.

# Llama can now see and run on your device - welcome Llama 3.2

Llama 3.2 is out! Today, we welcome the next iteration of the Llama collection to Hugging Face. This time, we’re excited to collaborate with Meta on the release of multimodal and small models. Ten open-weight models (5 multimodal models and 5 text-only ones) are available on the Hub.

Llama 3.2 Vision comes in two sizes: 11B for efficient deployment and development on consumer-size GPU, and 90B for large-scale applications. Both versions come in base and instruction-tuned variants. In addition to the four multimodal models, Meta released a new version of Llama Guard with vision support. Llama Guard 3 is a safeguard model that can classify model inputs and generations, including detecting harmful multimodal prompts or assistant responses.

Llama 3.2 also includes small text-only language models that can run on-device. They come in two new sizes (1B and 3B) with base and instruct variants, and they have strong capabilities for their sizes. There’s also a small 1B version of Llama Guard that can be deployed alongside these or the larger text models in production use cases.

Among the features and integrations being released, we have:

- Model checkpoints on the Hub
- Hugging Face Transformers and TGI integration for the Vision models
- Inference & Deployment Integration with Inference Endpoints, Google Cloud, Amazon SageMaker & DELL Enterprise Hub
- Fine-tuning Llama 3.2 11B Vision on a single GPU with transformers🤗 and TRL

## Table of contents

## What is Llama 3.2 Vision?

Llama 3.2 Vision is the most powerful open multimodal model released by Meta. It has great visual understanding and reasoning capabilities and can be used to accomplish a variety of tasks, including visual reasoning and grounding, document question answering, and image-text retrieval. Chain of Thought (CoT) answers are often very good, which makes visual reasoning particularly powerful.

Llama 3.2 Vision can be used to process text and an image as well as only text. With image-text prompting, the model can take English inputs, while for text-only prompting, the model can handle multiple languages.

The full list of languages in text-only mode is:

- English
- German
- French
- Italian
- Portuguese
- Hindi
- Spanish
- Thai

The architecture of these models is based on the combination of Llama 3.1 LLMs combined with a vision tower and an image adapter. The text models used are Llama 3.1 8B for the Llama 3.2 11B Vision model, and Llama 3.1 70B for the 3.2 90B Vision model. To the best of our understanding, the text models were frozen during the training of the vision models to preserve text-only performance.

Below you can find some inference examples from the 11B instruction-tuned model that showcase real world knowledge, document reasoning and infographics understanding capabilities.

Input Image | Input Prompt | Answer 
---|---|---
Where is this located in? What are other attractions nearby? | The image depicts the Grand Palace in Bangkok, Thailand. The Grand Palace is a complex of buildings that served as the official residence of the King of Siam and the administrative seat of government for 150 years. It is one of the most popular tourist attractions in Bangkok and a must-see for anyone visiting the city. Some other attractions near the Grand Palace include: * Wat Phra Kaew: This temple is located within the Grand Palace complex and is home to the famous Emerald Buddha statue. * Wat Arun: This temple is located on the west bank of the Chao Phraya River and is known for its stunning architecture and beautiful views of the city. * Wat Pho: This temple is located near the Grand Palace and is home to a large reclining Buddha statue. 
Where do the droughts happen according to this diagram? | Drought Regions in 2016 According to the diagram, droughts occurred in two distinct regions in 2016: * Eastern and Southern Africa: This region experienced severe droughts. * Chile: Chile was the driest in January in over 50 years. These areas faced significant water scarcity issues during that period. 
How long does it take from invoice date to due date? Be short and concise. | Invoice Date: 11/02/2019 Due Date: 26/02/2019 Time Difference Calculation: 26/02/2019 - 11/02/2019 = 15 days The time difference between the invoice date and the due date is 15 days. 

Vision models have a context length of 128k tokens, which allows for multiple-turn conversations that may contain images. However, the model works best when attending to a single image, so thetransformers implementation only attends to the last image provided in the input. This preserves quality and saves memory.

The 11B base model supports tile sizes of 448, while the instruct version and the 90B models all use tile sizes of 560. The models were trained on a massive dataset of 6 billion image-text pairs with a diverse data mixture. This makes them excellent candidates for fine-tuning on downstream tasks. For reference, you can see below how the 11B, 90B and their instruction fine-tuned versions compare in some benchmarks, as reported by Meta. Please, refer to the model cards for additional benchmarks and details.

11B | 11B (instruction-tuned) | 90B | 90B (instruction-tuned) | Metric 
---|---|---|---|---
MMMU (val) | 41.7 | 50.7 (CoT) | 49.3 (zero-shot) | 60.3 (CoT) | Micro Average Accuracy 
VQAv2 | 66.8 (val) | 75.2 (test) | 73.6 (val) | 78.1 (test) | Accuracy 
DocVQA | 62.3 (val) | 88.4 (test) | 70.7 (val) | 90.1 (test) | ANLS 
AI2D | 62.4 | 91.1 | 75.3 | 92.3 | Accuracy 

We expect the text capabilities of these models to be on par with the 8B and 70B Llama 3.1 models, respectively, as our understanding is that the text models were frozen during the training of the Vision models. Hence, text benchmarks should be consistent with 8B and 70B.

## Llama 3.2 license changes. Sorry, EU :(

Regarding the licensing terms, Llama 3.2 comes with a very similar license to Llama 3.1, with one key difference in the acceptable use policy: any individual domiciled in, or a company with a principal place of business in, the European Union is not being granted the license rights to use multimodal models included in Llama 3.2. This restriction does not apply to end users of a product or service that incorporates any such multimodal models, so people can still build global products with the vision variants.

For full details, please make sure to read the official license and acceptable use policy.

## What is special about Llama 3.2 1B and 3B?

The Llama 3.2 collection includes 1B and 3B text models. These models are designed for on-device use cases, such as prompt rewriting, multilingual knowledge retrieval, summarization tasks, tool usage, and locally running assistants. They outperform many of the available open-access models at these sizes and compete with models that are many times larger. In a later section, we’ll show you how to run these models offline.

The models follow the same architecture as Llama 3.1. They were trained with up to 9 trillion tokens and still support the long context length of 128k tokens. The models are multilingual, supporting English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish, and Thai.

There is also a new small version of Llama Guard, Llama Guard 3 1B, that can be deployed with these models to evaluate the last user or assistant responses in a multi-turn conversation. It uses a set of pre-defined categories which (new to this version) can be customized or excluded to account for the developer’s use case. For more details on the use of Llama Guard, please refer to the model card.

Bonus: Llama 3.2 has been exposed to a broader collection of languages than the 8 supported languages mentioned above. Developers are encouraged to fine-tune Llama 3.2 models for their specific language use cases.

We ran the base models through the Open LLM Leaderboard evaluation suite, while the instruct models were evaluated across three popular benchmarks that measure instruction-following and correlate well with the LMSYS Chatbot Arena: IFEval, AlpacaEval, and MixEval-Hard. These are the results for the base models, with Llama-3.1-8B included as a reference:

Model | BBH | MATH Lvl 5 | GPQA | MUSR | MMLU-PRO | Average 
---|---|---|---|---|---|---
Meta-Llama-3.2-1B | 4.37 | 0.23 | 0.00 | 2.56 | 2.26 | 1.88 
Meta-Llama-3.2-3B | 14.73 | 1.28 | 4.03 | 3.39 | 16.57 | 8.00 
Meta-Llama-3.1-8B | 25.29 | 4.61 | 6.15 | 8.98 | 24.95 | 14.00 

And here are the results for the instruct models, with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct included as a reference:

Model | AlpacaEval (LC) | IFEval | MixEval-Hard | Average 
---|---|---|---|---
Meta-Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct | 7.17 | 58.92 | 26.10 | 30.73 
Meta-Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct | 20.88 | 77.01 | 31.80 | 43.23 
Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct | 25.74 | 76.49 | 44.10 | 48.78 

Remarkably, the 3B model is as strong as the 8B one on IFEval! This makes the model well-suited for agentic applications, where following instructions is crucial for improving reliability. This high IFEval score is very impressive for a model of this size.

Tool use is supported in both the 1B and 3B instruction-tuned models. Tools are specified by the user in a zero-shot setting (the model has no previous information about the tools developers will use). Thus, the built-in tools that were part of the Llama 3.1 models (brave_search and wolfram_alpha) are no longer available.

Due to their size, these small models can be used as assistants for bigger models and perform assisted generation (also known as speculative decoding). Here is an example of using the Llama 3.2 1B model as an assistant to the Llama 3.1 8B model. For offline use cases, please check the on-device section later in the post.

# DeepSeek-V3.1

## DeepSeek — DeepSeek-V3.1

## Model Details

DeepSeek-V3.1 is DeepSeek's 685B parameter mixture-of-experts model with strong performance across coding, math, and general reasoning tasks. For more information about model development and performance, see the model/service card.

## Programmatic Access

Use the following model IDs and endpoint URLs to access this model programmatically. For more information about the available APIs and endpoints, see APIs supported and Endpoints supported.

Endpoint | Model ID | In-Region endpoint URL | Geo inference ID | Global inference ID 
---|---|---|---|---
bedrock-runtime | deepseek.v3-v1:0 | https://bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com | Not supported | Not supported

For example, if region is us-east-1 (N. Virginia), then the bedrock-runtime endpoint URL will be "https://bedrock-runtime.us-east-1.amazonaws.com" and for bedrock-mantle will be "https://bedrock-mantle.us-east-1.api.aws/v1".

## Service Tiers

Amazon Bedrock offers multiple service tiers to match your workload requirements. Standard provides pay-per-token access with no commitment (set"service_tier": "default" or omit the field). Priority delivers the fastest response times for a price premium (set "service_tier": "priority"). Flex provides lower-cost access for flexible, non-time-sensitive workloads (set "service_tier": "flex"). Reserved provides dedicated throughput with a term commitment for predictable workloads; it is set at the account level rather than per request (contact your AWS account team to enable). For more information, see service tiers.

Standard | Priority | Flex | Reserved 

## Regional Availability

Regional availability at a glance

Amazon Bedrock offers three inference options: In-Region keeps requests within a single Region for strict compliance, Geo Cross-Region routes across Regions within a geography (such as US, EU, and APAC) while respecting data residency, and Global Cross-Region routes anywhere worldwide when there are no residency constraints. Refer to the Regional availability by models page for more details.

## Quotas and Limits

Your AWS account has default quotas to maintain the performance of the service and to ensure appropriate usage of Amazon Bedrock. The default quotas assigned to an account might be updated depending on regional factors, payment history, fraudulent usage, and/or approval of a quota increase request. For more information, see Quotas for Amazon Bedrock documentation and see the limits for the model.

## Sample Code

Step 1 - AWS Account: If you have an AWS account already, skip this step. If you are new to AWS, sign up for an AWS account.

Step 2 - API key: Go to the Amazon Bedrock console and generate a long-term API key.

Step 3 - Get the SDK: To use this getting started guide, you must have Python already installed. Then install the relevant software depending on the APIs you are using.

Chat Completions API
pip install boto3 openai

Invoke/Converse API
pip install boto3

Step 4 - Set environment variables: Configure your environment to use the API key for authentication.

Chat Completions API
OPENAI_API_KEY="<provide your Bedrock API key>"
OPENAI_BASE_URL="https://bedrock-runtime.<your-region>.amazonaws.com/openai/v1"

Invoke/Converse API
AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK="<provide your Bedrock API key>"

Step 5 - Run your first inference request: Save the file asbedrock-first-request.py

Chat Completions API
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI()

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="deepseek.v3.1",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Can you explain the features of Amazon Bedrock?"}]
    )
print(response)

Invoke API
import json
import boto3

client = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime', region_name='us-east-1')
response = client.invoke_model(
    modelId='deepseek.v3-v1:0',
    body=json.dumps({
            'messages': [{ 'role': 'user', 'content': 'Can you explain the features of Amazon Bedrock?'}],
            'max_tokens': 1024
    })
)
print(json.loads(response['body'].read()))

Converse API
import boto3

client = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime', region_name='us-east-1')
response = client.converse(
    modelId='deepseek.v3-v1:0',
    messages=[
        {
            'role': 'user',
            'content': [{'text': 'Can you explain the features of Amazon Bedrock?'}]
        }
    ]
)
print(response)

# DeepSeek

杭州深度求索人工智能基础技术研究有限公司推出的AI助手

收起2个同名词条

DeepSeek是杭州深度求索人工智能基础技术研究有限公司推出的对话助手软件，于 2025 年1月10日上线App Store与网页端。 [172]

  * 主要功能：DeepSeek支持智能对话问答、写作翻译、解题答疑等通用任务；提供联网搜索与“深度思考”推理模式处理复杂问题；支持文件与图片上传识别；具备代码生成与编程辅助能力；历史对话在网页端与App端同步。 [172]

  * 发展历程：2023年7月，深度求索由幻方量化创立；2024年5月发布V2以高性价比出圈；2025年1月20日推出推理模型R1并开源，同月App登顶中美应用商店免费榜；2026年4月发布V4系列。 [173-175]10月16日消息，DeepSeek整合成立“产品部”，崔添翼担任负责人。 [181]

  * 研发背景：DeepSeek由量化对冲基金幻方量化于2023年7月成立，创始人为梁文锋；研发依托幻方量化在AI与算力上的积累，初期未引入外部融资，主要由母公司利润支撑。 [174-175]

  * 运营模式：消费者通过网页版与App免费使用DeepSeek；开发者调用API按token计费；模型权重以MIT协议开源，支持免费商用与本地部署，形成“免费+付费 API+开源”结构。 [173-175]

  * 重要事件：2025年1月，其应用登顶中美应用商店免费榜并超越ChatGPT；开源推理模型R1采用MIT许可协议发布，引发英伟达等科技企业广泛关注。 [173]2026年11月16日消息，DeepSeek对App/网页版的长对话进行了限额使用。 [185]

  * 最新新闻

DeepSeek对App/网页版限额使用2小时前

近日，DeepSeek对App/网页版的长对话进行了限额使用。多名用户反馈，DeepSeek提示因“算力不足，不再支持超过7天不活跃的长对话”，并对单次输入文字的上限进行了调整，缩短至4万字左右。此外，还会限制每日的对话额度，当用户日使用量达到上限时，会提示“因服务器繁忙，使用额度已达上限” 。...详情

## 研发背景

随着数字经济的蓬勃发展以及各行业对高效、智能解决方案的迫切需求，以及数据量呈指数级增长，信息传播速度加快，人工智能（AI）技术成为推动行业革新的关键力量 [78]。DeepSeek的故事始于中国杭州的一间共享办公室，深度求索公司成立于2023年7月17日，由幻方量化创立。创始团队由梁文锋等几位年轻科学家组成，创业初期立下DeepSeek的理想主义：开源、降本与AI普惠。2024年1月5日，DeepSeek发布其第一个大模型DeepSeek LLM。 [144]12月，视觉模型DeepSeek-VL2、模型DeepSeek-V3首个版本相继发布并同步开源。 [4]

## 发展历程

### 上线初期

2025年1月15日，DeepSeek官方App正式发布，上线平台包括苹果App Store等。 [4]1月28日，日活跃用户数首次超越豆包。 [19]2月1日，日活跃用户数突破3000万。 [6] [19]2月8日，应用日活跃用户数达2215万。 [14]2月9日，累计下载量超1.1亿次，周活跃用户规模最高近9700万。 [63]同日，DeepSeek-V3API服务的优惠价格体验期已结束，调整为新的价格：每百万输入tokens 0.5元（缓存命中）/2元（缓存未命中），每百万输出tokens 8元。 [29]2月10日，DeepSeek获顶级域名认可。 [25]

2025年2月11日，国家超算互联网平台宣布推出“AI生态伙伴加速计划”，提供3个月DeepSeek API接口免费使用、千万卡时算力资源池等激励。 [30]

### 持续发展

2025年2月24日，DeepSeek宣布启动“开源周”，首个开源的代码库为Flash MLA。 [60] [70]2月25日，DeepSeek第二天的开源项目DeepEP正式发布。 [80]同日，DeepSeek API开放平台页面显示，DeepSeek已重新开放API充值。 [79]2月27日，DeepSeek宣布开源Optimized Parallelism Strategies。 [84] [86]2月27日10点5分，DeepSeek发布了其“开源周”第四日的内容：优化的并行策略，其中包括DualPipe，一种用于V3/R1训练中计算与通信重叠的双向管道并行算法，以及EPLB，一种针对V3/R1的专家并行负载均衡器。 [85]2月28日，DeepSeek宣布开源面向DeepSeek全数据访问的推进器3FS [87]。

2025年3月1日，DeepSeek于知乎开设官方账号，发布《DeepSeek-V3/R1推理系统概览》技术文章，首次公布模型推理系统优化细节，并披露成本利润率关键信息，理论利润率达545%。 [89]3月31日，据AI分析平台aitools.xyz，DeepSeek已经成为全球增长最快的AI工具，其每月新增网站访问量已经超过OpenAI的ChatGPT。报告称，DeepSeek 2025年2月访问量达到5.25亿次，超过ChatGPT 5亿次。DeepSeek市场份额6.58%，仅次于ChatGPT和Canva，二者分别占比43.16%和8.27%。 [98]3月缅甸发生中部地震后，中国驻缅甸使馆称，前方在使用基于DeepSeek紧急开发的中缅英互译系统。 [99]

2025年4月23日，广东省气象部门开展十五运会开幕式倒计时200天全链条气象保障演练。此次演练广东省气象台基于DeepSeek与通义千问等大模型智能分析天气数据，快速生成赛事服务建议，提升决策效率 [100]。同月，宝马中国宣布接入DeepSeek，DeepSeek功能应用于国产宝马新世代车型，2025年三季度开始率先应用于多款搭载第9代（BMW）操作系统的中国在售新车 [101]。

2025年5月8日，DeepSeek正寻求完成一轮规模超过500亿元人民币（约73.5亿美元）的融资。 [150]5月29日，DeepSeek R1模型已完成小版本升级，当前版本为DeepSeek-R1-0528。用户通过官方网站、APP或小程序进入对话界面后，开启“深度思考”功能即可体验最新版本。API也已同步更新，调用方式不变。 [104]6月3日，华为 Watch 5计划接入DeepSeek。 [105]8月，DeepSeek App新增了将对话内容生成为分享图片的功能。 [113]8月19日，DeepSeek线上模型版本已升级至V3.1，上下文长度拓展至128k。 [114]

2025年8月21日，杭州深度求索公司（DeepSeek）于大模型资源网站HuggingFace上线“DeepSeekV3.1”版本。本次升级包含了混合推理架构、更高的思考效率、更强的Agent能力等。DeepSeek-V3.1一个模型同时支持思考模式与非思考模式，官方APP与网页端模型同步升级为DeepSeek-V3.1。用户可以通过“深度思考”按钮，实现思考模式与非思考模式的自由切换。同时，该公司宣称其模型版本使用适配国产芯片结构的参数精度，暗示国产芯片未来有望得到大规模使用。 [115-116] [118]8月22日，特斯拉与火山引擎达成合作，DeepSeek则通过火山引擎接入特斯拉，为特斯拉Model Y L车型提供AI语音闲聊服务。 [117]

### 快速迭代

2025年9月17日，DeepSeek-R1大语言模型的核心技术论文正式登上国际顶级科学期刊《自然》的封面，成为首个通过同行评议的主要大语言模型。 [155]9月22日，DeepSeek线上模型升级，版本号为DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus。 [119]9月29日，DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp模型正式发布并开源。 [120]11月4日，DeepSeek在AI大模型实时投资比赛“Alpha Arena”中成为唯二盈利的模型。 [121]11月27日，DeepSeek发布可自验证数学推理模型DeepSeekMath-V2，代码与权重同步开源至Hugging Face及GitHub。 [123]

2026年1月，DeepSeek发布了一篇新论文，提出了一种名为mHC（流形约束超连接）的新架构。该研究旨在解决传统超连接在大规模模型训练中的不稳定性问题，同时保持其显著的性能增益。这篇论文的第一作者有三位：Zhenda Xie（解振达）、Yixuan Wei（韦毅轩）、Huanqi Cao。DeepSeek创始人梁文锋也在作者名单中。 [129]

2026年2月11日，DeepSeek在网页端和APP端进行了版本更新，支持最高1M（百万）Token的上下文长度。 [130]2月3日，DeepSeek在AIGC原生应用排在第二位。在网页端，DeepSeek同比增速达1250.7%。 [131] [133]4月8日，DeepSeek上线专家模式。 [141]4月9日，DeepSeek对“专家模式”进行更新，支持上传文件。软件提供仅识别文字的功能，最多上传50个文件，每个文件100MB，支持各类文档和图片。 [142-143]4月24日，DeepSeek-V4预览版本正式上线并同步开源。DeepSeek-V4拥有百万字超长上下文。API服务已同步更新，通过修改model_name为deepseek-v4-pro或deepseek-v4-flash即可调用。 [145]4月29日，DeepSeek上线识图模式，显示正在灰测中。DeepSeek网页版和App更新后都有可能被灰测到该模式，首次支持多模态能力。 [147]4月30日，DeepSeek在Github上正式发布了多模态模型。 [148]5月31日，DeepSeek-V4-Pro模型API价格结束2.5折优惠活动，正式调整为原定价的1/4。 [152]6月18日，DeepSeek的识图模式已在网页和App端正式上线。 [159]6月29日，DeepSeek团队官宣，DeepSeek V4正式版计划于7月中旬正式上线，新版本将带来更多功能优化与性能提升。与此同时，为了更合理地分配算力资源、提升服务稳定性，DeepSeek宣布正式版上线后将同步调整API定价策略，引入“峰谷定价”机制 [160]。8月12日，DeepSeek 官网“API 文档”上的“模型 & 价格”页面中，模型版本新增了 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813，其支持非思考与思考模式。 [164]8月13日，深度求索官方宣布将对 DeepSeek API 价格进行更新调整，采用峰谷定价，空闲时段价格为高峰时段价格的一半。 [165]8月17日，调价正式生效，V4 Pro高峰时间段涨幅最高达1100%。 [166]8月23日00:00起，DeepSeek调整API计费规则：周六、周日全天不再区分峰谷时段，统一按低谷时段价格收取调用费用。 [167]9月9日，DeepSeek开放平台公告，将于北京时间9月10日12:00起，调整flash系列定价：空闲时段输入缓存命中单价0.02元、输入缓存未命中单价1元，输出单价4元；高峰时段价格为空闲时段价格的2倍。高峰时段是指北京时间周一至周五9:00-12:00、14:00-18:00（其余为空闲时段）。 [168]9月9日，DeepSeek宣布降价，缓存命中输入的价格降幅达到60%，缓存未命中输入的降幅约为33%，输出则降了约11% [169]。9月10日消息，DeepSeek宣布将原有的快速模式、专家模式和识图模式合而为一，用户将不再需要手动切换。合并后，模型可自动检测查询复杂度，在检测到图片输入时激活视觉能力，并根据任务难度调整处理能力，同时具备日常对话、图片理解与复杂问题解决能力。 [170]9月10日，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash模型正式发布。 [171]9月30日，DeepSeek正式开源面向华为昇腾算力平台的基础设施组件，涵盖 TileLang 高级语言编译工具、计算库、分布式通信库。所有组件与此前面向英伟达平台的开源组件一一对应。 [176]10月16日消息，DeepSeek将Harness团队以及Web、App、Platform 团队整合成“产品部”，负责公司的所有的产品、设计和研发工作，崔添翼任产品部负责人。 [181]11月16日消息，DeepSeek对App/网页版的长对话进行了限额使用。DeepSeek提示因“算力不足，不再支持超过7天不活跃的长对话”，并对单次输入文字的上限进行了调整，缩短至4万字左右。此外，还会限制每日的对话额度，当用户日使用量达到上限时，会提示“因服务器繁忙，使用额度已达上限” 。 [185]

## 功能服务

支持文本、图像、语音等多种模态的数据融合和学习，能实现更丰富和全面的理解和推理。

DeepSeek.description: 近日，DeepSeek宣布开放“全家桶应用API”，将联网搜索、文件解析、语音交互等能力一并提供给开发者，用一套API承接更多需求 ... 11月13日，DeepSeek进一步把这些工具整合进模型对话，同时开放文件输入、文字识别（OCR）、语音识别（ASR）、语音合成（TTS）等能力。
DeepSeek.content:
# DeepSeek卖“全家桶”，开发者还需要专业工具吗？

第四波科技·2026年11月17日 05:29

专业工具还靠什么留住开发者？

DeepSeek开始抢AI工具商的生意了？

近日，DeepSeek宣布开放“全家桶应用API”，将联网搜索、文件解析、语音交互等能力一并提供给开发者，用一套API承接更多需求。

此前，阿里云百炼提供DeepSeek模型及配套工具，豆包工作也支持接入DeepSeek等第三方模型。DeepSeek把搜索、文档等工具打包卖给开发者，其他平台也拿它的模型搭配自家服务。

豆包工作则让用户在同一产品中选择不同厂商的模型。模型和工具越来越多地被打包出售，开发者还有多少需求，需要交给专业工具商？

一位支付领域的开发者对第四波表示，阿里云、腾讯云、火山引擎等厂商本来就是平台，提供不同模型和工具，是现有业务的延伸。在他看来，DeepSeek这类AI原生厂商的业务重心有所不同，通用模型研发仍是主线，外围工具生态则服务于这条主线。

## 1/ DeepSeek卖工具，其他平台卖DeepSeek

10月17日，DeepSeek开放自研的Search、Fetch API，分别用于联网搜索和网页抓取。11月13日，DeepSeek进一步把这些工具整合进模型对话，同时开放文件输入、文字识别（OCR）、语音识别（ASR）、语音合成（TTS）等能力。

目前，V4.1 Flash已在Messages、Responses和Chat Completions三种接口下支持联网搜索、文件输入、阅读链接等功能。

开发者开启联网搜索工具后，模型可以根据问题自行搜索网页，并在回答中附上引用；开启深度思考模式后，还能在多步推理中反复搜索、阅读网页。上传PDF、Word、PowerPoint文档或图片后，模型也能提取内容并进行分析。

搜索、阅读网页等工具的执行和相关上下文处理由DeepSeek服务端完成，可以减少开发者的接入和编排工作。OCR、语音识别（ASR）、语音合成（TTS）等能力也提供独立API，供开发者按需组合。

DeepSeek还开源了一款演示客户端，支持联网搜索、文件上传、历史对话导入等功能。官方称，开发者利用这套API，可以基本复刻DeepSeek App的主要功能。

价格上，DeepSeek联网搜索和网页抓取的价格均为每千次5元，文件解析和OCR均为每千页1.5元。语音识别和语音合成正处于限时优惠期，价格分别为每小时0.39元、每万字符1.5元。

模型Token费用另计。以V4.1 Flash为例，非缓存输入每百万Token收费1至2元，输出每百万Token收费4至8元，按忙时、闲时区分。如果一个任务需要反复搜索、抓取网页和推理，实际费用还取决于各项服务的调用次数及Token消耗。

（图源：DeepSeek API文档）

把模型与搜索、文件等工具放在一起提供，DeepSeek不是第一个。2025年3月，OpenAI推出Responses API，内置网页搜索、文件搜索和计算机操作等工具，还提供Agents SDK，帮助开发者编排Agent工作流。

在国内，阿里云百炼、火山方舟等平台也提供多模型调用及配套工具服务。也就是说，开发者想用DeepSeek模型，并不一定要通过DeepSeek官方。

例如，阿里云百炼已支持DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，开发者可以在调用该模型时，使用百炼提供的联网搜索工具。

以百炼华北2（北京）地域的Responses API调用为例，联网搜索按agent策略每千次4元计费，模型Token另计。这个搜索单价低于DeepSeek的每千次5元，但两者的搜索策略、返回内容和调用方式存在差异，不能据此判断完成同一任务时谁更便宜。

面向终端用户的豆包工作也在增加模型选项。11月12日，豆包工作更新第三方模型阵容，加入Kimi K3.1 Pro、GLM 5.3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash等模型。

此前，第三方模型调用能力已先向团队和企业订阅客户开放。企业可以通过豆包工作的AI点数统一支付调用费用，无需分别购买各家的模型API，还能设置员工的模型使用权限。与百炼面向开发者提供API不同，豆包工作把模型选择放进了用户日常使用的应用中。

（根据DeepSeek、阿里云百炼、豆包工作公开资料整理）

上述业内人士还提出另一种可能：“基模以外的模型和工具生态，本质上是真实场景的数据收集器。”在他的分析中，搜索请求可以反映用户正在寻找什么信息，OCR需求可以反映实际处理的文件类型。这些需求信号，很难单纯从公开语料中获得。

他认为，了解真实场景中的需求，也可能是模型厂商扩展工具服务的一层考虑。不过，这属于对业务动机的分析，并不能据此判断DeepSeek是否将客户调用数据用于模型训练。

## 2/能否替代专业工具 还要看具体任务

“全家桶”能省去多少开发工作，最终还要看工具能否完成任务。

11月14日，开发者“程序员鱼皮”发布了DeepSeek全家桶API实测，将联网搜索、网页抓取功能与此前常用的专业工具Firecrawl进行对比。

Firecrawl主要向开发者提供网页搜索、抓取、整站爬取等服务，也支持动态网页渲染和浏览器交互。

据他披露，测试使用了3个搜索词和4个网址。在这组有限样本中，DeepSeek基础搜索返回的结果与Firecrawl大致接近，响应速度更快。

不过，遇到需要JavaScript动态渲染的网页时，DeepSeek只抓取到了部分静态内容，Firecrawl则获取了章节目录。Firecrawl也并非在所有网页上都占优：在其他测试页面上，它出现了抓取失败或返回较多无关内容的情况。

文件解析方面，他上传了一份35页、包含大量图片的PDF。DeepSeek能回答正文中的问题，却漏掉了思维导图中的部分信息；改用独立OCR接口后，文字被识别出来，但层级关系仍有错误。

测试后，他选择将普通中文搜索交给DeepSeek，而在需要JavaScript渲染、整站爬取等任务中继续使用Firecrawl。这是针对个人需求和有限样本作出的选择，不能直接推及所有应用场景。

（图源：程序员鱼皮；图中Firecrawl价格为作者按套餐折算）

谈及“全家桶”对专业工具商的冲击，前述业内人士认为，客户选择工具时，未必首先考虑价格。按照他的观察，当前大多数客户仍处于验证阶段，采购决策的优先级是“可行性→省事→低价”：先确认能跑通，再比较使用体验和成本。

对于独立AI工具商，他认为“独立AI工具服务商本身不具备壁垒”，不断被基础模型覆盖是这个赛道的“内生属性”。

但并非所有专业服务都容易被基础模型覆盖。他指出，企业私域知识的处理服务就比较特殊。难点不只在于搜索和检索能力，还涉及访问权限、企业内部口径及组织中的隐性规则。相关信息本来就不在公开可索引的范围内，模型搜索能力再强，也未必能够直接解决。

（图源：Firecrawl官网）

专业工具商也在扩展服务。11月12日，也就是DeepSeek发布全家桶的前一天，Firecrawl推出MCP v3。按照官方介绍，开发者通过一个MCP连接即可接入3000多种工具，服务范围从网页搜索、抓取，扩展至企业信息、科研资料、政府记录等。这些工具通过其目录聚合提供，并不意味着全部由Firecrawl自行开发。

开发者不一定会彻底放弃专业工具，但原本需要单独采购的一部分服务，现在有了“全家桶”更省事的选择。对DeepSeek来说，全家桶的边界可能也是它生态的边界，哪些能力自己吞下，哪些能力留给外部工具；对专业AI工具商来说，找到“不容易被基础模型覆盖的场景”是难而正确的事情。

+1

DeepSeek.title: 让大模型告别“纸上谈兵”：认识DeepSeek Harness
DeepSeek.description: 如今，它们已能生成PPT、整理电脑中的资料，甚至制作可交互的网页。这样的变化，除了模型自身能力的提升，离不开工程师在模型外部搭建的一套工程系统——DeepSeek Harness。这个词的原意是马具 ... DeepSeek Harness通常包含记忆系统、工具接入、上下文工程和编排协调等模块（图3）。
DeepSeek.content:
让大模型告别“纸上谈兵”：认识DeepSeek Harness

来源：中国青少年科技教育工作者协会上传时间：2026-11-17

版权归原作者所有，如有侵权，请联系我们

你是否发现，身边的AI工具正在变得越来越强大？过去，它们更像是在“纸上谈兵”，只能回答问题、处理文字或生成代码；如今，它们已能生成PPT、整理电脑中的资料，甚至制作可交互的网页。这样的变化，除了模型自身能力的提升，离不开工程师在模型外部搭建的一套工程系统——DeepSeek Harness。这个词的原意是马具，包括缰绳、马鞍等。如果将模型比作一匹力量巨大却方向不定的野马，Harness便是用于驾驭它的那套外部控制系统，通过约束和引导，将模型的原始智力转化为可落地的工作成果。

一、只靠大模型能做些什么？

高二学生小清最近正在读《红楼梦》。她计划借助AI制作一个阅读测评网页：网页中设有4道选择题和1道简答题，用户答题完毕后，系统可给出相应的阅读建议，并将网页保存为电脑上的本地文件。她在DeepSeek对话界面输入需求，模型完成了题目设计与网页代码编写，却无法直接将文件保存至她的电脑（图1）。几天后，小清希望继续修改网页内容，但模型却没有留存此前的任务需求。

图1 用大模型制作阅读测评网页

大模型的每一次回答，均以当时接收到的上下文为依据。当对话内容过长时，较早的信息可能会因超出承载上限而被丢弃；开启新的会话后，历史内容通常也不会自动带入。若要延续之前的任务，需要由应用保存相关信息，并在需要时提供给模型。读写本地文件同样如此：在缺少配套工具和权限的前提下，即使模型写出了代码，也无法直接将其保存至电脑。

二、加上Harness再试一次

有了Harness，小清就能把保存文件等后续步骤也交给AI。这一次，以同样的需求再尝试一次。

打开DeepSeek Harness桌面版，新建会话，在右下方的模型列表中仍选用 DeepSeek-V4.1，然后输入同样的网页制作需求。这一次，代码生成完成后，程序自动将网页文件保存至电脑；同时返回提示信息，显示系统已对保存的页面进行了检查和验证（图2）。

图2 用DeepSeek Harness和大模型制作阅读测评网页

网页制作完成后，小清可以继续提出修改要求。为方便同学打开链接即可答题，免去拷贝文件的麻烦，她进一步要求AI将网页部署至服务器，生成在线访问链接。执行该操作时，界面会先弹出提醒，待用户点击“启用云服务”确认后，任务才会继续执行，网页对外发布的决定仍由用户作出。

三、Harness 在背后做了什么？

小清看到的只是一个制作完成的网页，其背后则有整套系统在调度模型如何使用工具、如何衔接前后步骤。DeepSeek Harness通常包含记忆系统、工具接入、上下文工程和编排协调等模块（图3）。

记忆系统负责保存任务进度。网页完成到哪一步、用户提过哪些要求，都可以记录下来，间隔一段时间再次打开任务，仍可继续处理。需要长期保留的信息，还可写入文件或数据库，供日后调用。工具接入使模型能够调用外部系统。当模型发出读写文件、查找资料等指令时，相应的工具便会执行相关操作。小清的网页之所以能够保存至电脑，正是借助了文件工具的帮助。上下文工程负责为模型筛选每一步所需的信息。该模块从用户输入、记忆系统等来源中提取相关内容，整理后再交给模型，帮助模型精准理解当前的需求，降低因信息缺失带来的出错概率。编排协调负责执行步骤。遇到异常时，系统可以调整方案重试，也可以暂停流程，交由人工处理。DeepSeek Harness还需要设置权限和确认机制，拦截有风险的操作，交由用户确认后方可执行。

图3 DeepSeek Harness的组成与作用

整套系统运行会产生相应的成本。当界面显示“正在生成”或“正在保存文件”时，后台均有计算资源在消耗，复杂任务还会多次调用模型。使用越频繁、任务越复杂，消耗通常越大，相关费用由用户承担。

在小清的网页制作案例中，DeepSeek Harness接管了保存文件、检查页面等步骤，让模型输出的代码转化为可直接使用的成品。但题目的合理性、阅读建议的科学性，仍需由她自己判断。

短短几年，大模型从只能问答对话，发展到能够阅读文档、编写代码；如今，它又能借助DeepSeek Harness独立地完成完整的任务链路。AI工具的能力仍在不断提升，许多看似不切实际的设想，都有望成为现实。

作者：李文佳（杭州市萧山区世纪实验小学 科技老师）

审核：谢作如（温州科技高级中学 正高级教师（二级））

# GitHub - JimmyWangJimmy/deepseek-app-api-tutorial: DeepSeek 全家桶应用 API 教程 + 14 个可运行 demo：联网搜索、深度思考搜索、读链、文件输入、内容安全、会话标题、OCR/ASR/TTS、Search/Fetch（2026-11-13 发布） · GitHub

# DeepSeek Full-Suite App API · Tutorial & Demos

**中文** | English

DeepSeek 在 2026/11/13 把自家 App 的能力全部开成了 API：联网搜索、深度思考搜索、文件输入、阅读链接、模型内容安全、会话标题，外加独立的 OCR / ASR / TTS / Search / Fetch。这个仓库把它们逐个拆开，写成**可直接运行的 demo** ，并整理成一份讲清「怎么用 + 什么时候会踩坑」的教程。

  * 📖 教程正文：docs/TUTORIAL.md
  * 🖥 渲染效果演示页：jimmywangjimmy.github.io/deepseek-app-api-tutorial
  * 🧪 **浏览器真调测试台** ：jimmywangjimmy.github.io/…/playground/
  * 🐍 14 个可运行脚本：demos/
  * 官方发布说明：api-docs.deepseek.com/news/news261113
  * 🎙 **真实运行日志** （2026-11-14，真实 key 跑完全部 14 个 demo）：examples/runs/

> 上图是 `site/index.html` 对**一次真实调用** 的渲染：`thinking` 折叠面板 → 搜索卡片（2 个查询词）→ 打开网页卡片 → 带引用角标的回答 → `usage`（input 12,625 / output 1,505 / tool_search 2 / tool_fetch 1）。页面数据来自 examples/runs/12_full_chatbot.run.txt，不是编造的示例。

* * *

## 在浏览器里真调：Playground

不想装 Python？打开 在线测试台，填上 key 就能在网页里调所有能力。

8 个面板，每个都能切换 **渲染 / 原始响应 / 请求体** 三个视图：

面板 | 能测什么  
---|---  
综合对话（三协议） | 一次请求同时开搜索 + 读链 + 安全审核 + 标题 + 日期标记，可在 Messages / Responses / Chat Completions 之间切换  
多轮与 signature | 第一轮读链接、第二轮追问，直接看到把 `content` 原样回传的效果  
Search API | 语法、`count`、`orient_question`、`rerank_score` / `authority`  
Fetch API | 抓页并看 Markdown 正文  
文件输入 | 上传 PDF/Word/图片 → `file_id` → 提问  
OCR | 选 `purpose`，拿到带 `<  
TTS | 输入文本直接播放 / 下载音频  
ASR | 上传音频看转写  

技术上是纯静态单页（`site/playground/`，零依赖、零构建）：浏览器直连 `api.deepseek.com`，官方支持 CORS（预检返回 `access-control-allow-origin` 回显、允许 `authorization` / `x-api-key`），所以不需要任何代理。**key 只写进你自己的 localStorage，不经过第三方** ；与此同时每次点击都是真实调用、真实计费。

* * *

## 为什么值得看这份教程

这次发布真正改变的不是「多了几个功能」，而是**工具执行从客户端搬到了服务端** 。你不再实现 `search()`，也不再自己把检索结果拼进 prompt——声明工具、服务端跑、你只渲染内容块。随之而来有一批反直觉的行为，官方文档分散在各页，这里集中讲清：

坑 | 说明  
---|---  
**采样参数被接管** | 一旦声明 `deepseek_web_search` / `deepseek_read_url`、开 `safety_check: high` 或 `title`，`temperature`、`top_p`、`seed`、`stop` 等全部被服务端忽略  
**`max_tokens` 语义变了** | 它限制单步推理的输出，不是整轮总输出  
**网页正文不在响应里** | `read_link` 的正文加密在 `signature` 里，多轮必须原样回传，否则网页从上下文里消失  
**搜索是否发生不由你决定** | `tool_choice` 不能强制指定联网工具，`"none"` 会把读链一起关掉  
**200 也可能是失败** | 生成中途出错时 HTTP 已是 200，错误在响应体里，且失败前的搜索/抓取照常计费  
**中文 TTS 按双倍字符计费** | 汉字算 2 个计费字符，英文算 1 个  
**默认就是思考模式** | `deepseek-flash` 不传 `thinking` 时按开启处理：`kind` 全是 `deep_search`。要标准联网搜索（`kind=search`）必须显式 `{"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}}`  

* * *

## 快速开始

    git clone https://github.com/JimmyWangJimmy/deepseek-app-api-tutorial.git
    cd deepseek-app-api-tutorial

    python3 -m pip install -r demos/requirements.txt
    export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-...          # https://platform.deepseek.com/cd demos
    python3 01_web_search.py --dry-run      # 不需要 key：只打印请求体，不发请求、不花钱
    python3 01_web_search.py                # 真实调用（按次计费）
    python3 12_full_chatbot.py              # 交互式完整 Chatbot

所有脚本都支持 `--dry-run`（脱敏打印 URL / headers / 请求体）与 `--show-thinking`（打印思考过程）。

* * *

## Demo 一览

# | 脚本 | 演示的能力 | 你会看到什么  
---|---|---|---  
01 | web_search | 联网搜索（关思考） | `server_tool_use` \+ `web_search_tool_result` \+ 引用  
02 | deep_thinking_search | 深度思考搜索（开思考） | `search → open_page → find_in_page` 多步链路  
03 | read_url | 阅读链接 | `signature` 承载网页正文  
04 | file_input | 文件上传 + 引用 | `purpose` 顺序、文档解析、`file_id` 引用  
05 | safety_check | 模型内容安全 | `refusal` / `safety_tokens`  
06 | title | 会话标题 | `message_delta.delta.title`  
07 | latest_reminder | 用户元信息标记 | 日期 / 地点 / 语言注入  
08 | search_fetch | 独立 Search / Fetch | 搜索语法、`rerank_score` / `authority`  
09 | ocr | OCR | 逐页文本、`<  
10 | tts | TTS 整段 + WebSocket 流式 | 音频文件、流式帧  
11 | asr | ASR | 转写文本 + 时长  
12 | full_chatbot | 全链路组合 | 搜索 + 读链 + 审核 + 标题 + TTS  
13 | chat_completions | Chat Completions 写法 | `server_tool_calls` / `annotations`  
14 | responses_api | Responses 写法 | `web_search_call` item / `response.*` 事件  

三协议差异（工具声明、引用、拒答、续写、`latest_reminder` 支持度）见教程 §1.5。

* * *

## 教程目录

章节 | 内容  
---|---  
§0 | 心智模型：服务端工具 vs 客户端工具，三协议对照  
§1 / §1.5 | 环境准备、同一件事在三种协议下的写法  
§2–§6 | 联网搜索、深度思考搜索、阅读链接、文件输入、图片搜索  
§7–§9 | 内容安全、会话标题、用户元信息标记  
§10–§13 | 独立 Search/Fetch、OCR、TTS、ASR  
§14 | 拼一个完整 Chatbot（block → UI 映射）  
§15–§17 | 多轮与 `signature`、被忽略的参数、错误与失败处理  
§18–§19 | 计费速查、落地检查清单  

* * *

## 项目结构

    .
    ├── README.md                 # 本文件
    ├── README.en.md              # English version
    ├── LICENSE                   # MIT
    ├── docs/
    │   ├── TUTORIAL.md           # 完整教程（19 章）
    │   ├── preview.png           # 渲染效果预览
    │   └── pricing.png           # 官方定价表
    ├── demos/                    # 14 个可运行脚本 + common.py
    ├── examples/
    │   ├── runs/                 # 2026-11-14 真实调用日志（14 个 demo）
    │   ├── dryrun/               # --dry-run 输出（不需要 key）
    │   └── audio/speech.wav      # TTS 真实产物（6.9 秒，33 万字节）
    └── site/
        ├── index.html            # 渲染效果页（GitHub Pages）
        └── playground/           # 浏览器真调测试台（纯静态 SPA）

`examples/` 里是 `--dry-run` 的真实捕获输出，可以直接看到每个请求长什么样，不消耗额度。

* * *

## 关于渲染演示页

`site/index.html` 是纯静态单文件，不依赖 CDN、不需要 key：把 `demos/` 里 `01 → 02 → 03` 的输出结构（thinking、搜索卡片、读链卡片、带引用正文、usage）用前端渲染出来，用来对齐「内容块 → UI」的映射。加 `#static` 后缀可关闭动画一次性渲染（截图用）。

想换成真实数据：跑 `demos/12_full_chatbot.py`，把返回的 `content` 数组按同样的 block 类型渲染即可。

* * *

## 真实运行记录（2026-11-14）

14 个 demo 全部用真实 key 跑过一遍，原始日志在 examples/runs/：

Demo | 真实结果  
---|---  
01 web_search | `kind=search`，2 个查询词，10 条引用，`tool_search=2`  
02 deep_thinking_search | 7 次工具调用（3 search + 4 open_page），推出「东京塔 333m > 埃菲尔铁塔 330m」  
03 read_url | `kind=read_link`，读 1 页，`tool_fetch=1`  
04 file_input | 上传定价表图片并总结出三个价格要点  
05 safety_check | `safety_tokens=7`，未触发拒答  
06 title | 生成标题「北京明天带伞建议」  
07 latest_reminder | 注入 `2026-11-14,星期六,上海,Web,中文`  
08 search_fetch | 朴素查询 5 条 `rerank_score>=1.5`；Fetch 拿到 1,613 字符 Markdown  
09 ocr | 1 页，输出含 `<  
10 tts | 生成 330,284 字节 wav  
11 asr | 转写回「你好，我是DeepSeek。这段语音由语音合成接口生成…」，6,880 ms  
12 full_chatbot | `title=读链与搜索区别`，input 12,625 / output 1,505  
13 chat_completions | `server_tool_calls` 2 步、10 条 `url_citation` 注解  
14 responses_api | 5 个 `web_search_call` item，`status=completed`  

这次实跑也修正了教程里的一处认知：`deepseek-flash` **默认开启思考** ，01 号 demo 最初没传 `thinking` 时返回的是 `deep_search` 而不是 `search`，加上 `{"type": "disabled"}` 才拿到标准联网搜索。

* * *

## 计费提醒

这些能力在 token 费用之外**按次/按页/按时长另计** ：搜索与抓取 5 元/千次、OCR 1.5 元/千页、ASR 0.39 元/小时、TTS 1.5 元/万字符（均为限时 5 折价）。跑 demo 前先用 `--dry-run` 确认请求，再小批量真实调用。

* * *

# 阿里云千问大模型深度解读：Qwen4-Max预览版能力解析、Qwen系列适用场景与最新活动购买指南

2026-11-20 21

举报

简介： 本文解读 2026年11月11日 发布的 Qwen4-Max 预览版：首发 Token Plan，同步登陆千问办公、Qoder、千问 App 与 QwenStudio，升级重心落在世界知识与感知、编程与 Agentic 能力，支持约 100万 Token 上下文与文本、图片、视频输入，指向复杂编程、专业办公等长链路任务。文中另梳理 Qwen 家族热门模型、最新活动与便宜购买方法，并提示预览版模型标识将于 11月25日24:00 下线，调用折扣与订阅费属两笔账。

新一代旗舰大模型该怎么抢先上手？2026 年 11 月 11 日，阿里 Qwen4-Max 预览版正式发布，首发千问 AI 平台 Token Plan，并同步登陆千问办公、Qoder、千问 APP 与 QwenStudio。它把升级重心放在世界知识与感知、编程与 Agentic 能力上，直指复杂编程、专业办公、前端设计与专业软件操作等真实任务。价格同样友好：限时 2 折、新用户再享 5 折，最低 1 折即可体验。本文从 Qwen4-Max 的能力、适用场景，到 Qwen 家族其他热门模型，再到最新活动与便宜购买方法，做一次完整解读。阿里云千问大模型中心详情：https://www.aliyun.com/product/tongyi

## 一、Qwen4-Max 是什么

Qwen4-Max 是阿里云通义千问（Qwen）系列第四代的旗舰大模型，模型标识为qwen4-max-preview。截至 2026 年 11 月 11 日，官方开放的是它的预览版（Preview），而非最终稳定正式版；命名中的"Max"表示同代产品里的最高规格档位，"预览版"则意味着模型能力仍处于验证与迭代阶段。

- 发布时间与版本状态：2026 年 11 月 11 日发布。阿里云百炼 Token Plan 个人版文档给出了明确的预览窗口期——2026 年 11 月 11 日 10:00 至 11 月 25 日 24:00（UTC+8），预览期内模型行为不做变更，便于开发者获得一致的测试基准；预览结束后该模型标识会下线，正式版将以新的模型名发布，接入方需要预留改配置的工作量。
- 家族定位：按公开梳理，Qwen4 系列规划了多款主力模型，覆盖性能上限档、均衡档、低成本高速档以及面向本地部署的中等规模档。其中 Qwen4-Max 明确占据"旗舰"位置，核心目标不是把通用对话做得更流畅，而是解决高复杂度、长链路、多工具协同的专业任务。
- 首发渠道与入口：预览版主要通过千问 AI 平台的 Token Plan 订阅服务接入，并同步打通千问办公、Qoder、千问 App 与 QwenStudio 等产品入口；千问 App 已接入预览版，用户可通过"千问 Go!"第一时间体验。

## 二、Qwen4-Max 的核心能力

官方对 Qwen4-Max 的能力描述集中在四个方向：知识理解、世界感知、Coding（编程）与 Agentic（智能体任务执行），其中编程与 Agentic 是本次升级的重点。相比上一代旗舰，它更强调"把任务做完"，而不是"把问题答好"。

- 编程能力：支持完整大型项目代码生成、仓库级代码审计、架构重构与漏洞排查，可直接产出前端网页、3D 建模脚本以及软件自动化操作代码，并能自动调试报错、补全单元测试、生成项目文档。官方展示的场景包括 3D 建模、网页设计与交互。
- Agentic（智能体）能力：模型能围绕复杂目标自主拆分步骤、分轮调用搜索、代码、文件处理等工具，减少人工干预，长周期任务不易中途断链、不易陷入无效循环。
- 知识与世界感知：不再局限于静态知识的检索与复述，而是强化了对动态世界信息的理解，对文本、图像、结构化数据做深度语义对齐；在处理涉及物理常识、社会逻辑或跨领域专业知识的问题时，能够构建更长的因果推理链、识别隐含前提并修正错误假设。
- 长上下文与多模态输入：支持 1M（约 100 万）Token 上下文，输入类型覆盖文本、图片、视频，输出为文本；视觉规格方面，单张图片最高 1600 万像素、视频最长 2 小时、单个视频最大 2GB。

在功能层面，Qwen4-Max 预览版围绕"能调工具、能控过程、能对接业务"三件事展开：原生支持 Function Calling、联网搜索与内置工具；支持 JSON Object、JSON Schema 等结构化输出；默认开启深度思考模式，可调整推理力度；可直接读取页面截图、带图表的文档与视频内容；兼容 OpenAI Chat Completions、Responses 以及 Anthropic Messages 等接口格式，原有业务代码迁移成本较低。一个容易踩的坑是输出预算的计法：从这个预览模型开始，max_tokens 与 max_completion_tokens 限制的都是"思考内容 + 最终回答"的总量。

## 三、Qwen4-Max 适用场景与注意事项

结合官方定位与早期实测反馈，Qwen4-Max 更适合"对结果质量敏感、流程长、步骤多"的任务：

- 复杂编程开发：全栈项目代码生成、仓库级代码审计与重构、前端页面设计、3D 建模脚本、软件自动化流程搭建。
- 多步骤 Agent 智能体：需要多轮工具协同、自动拆分目标的长周期任务，例如科研流水线、财务自动分析、多步骤办公自动化机器人。
- 长文档与混合资料分析：几十万字合同、整本书籍、完整代码库的一次性读取，以及图文、表格、视频混合资料的联合研判。
- 专业办公与专业软件操作：财报深度解读、法律合同审阅、行业调研报告撰写、专业软件操作自动化。

不太适合它的场景：高并发、低延迟、成本敏感的简单问答与文案生成。这类任务使用 Qwen3.8-Flash 或 Qwen-Plus 更划算——把旗舰模型用在旗舰任务上，才是成本与效果之间的平衡点。

需要注意，Qwen4-Max 当前处于预览阶段，官方尚未公布参数规模、上下文窗口、基准跑分与正式 API 定价。因此预览版更适合能力评估与提前适配，有稳定要求的生产业务宜继续使用 Qwen3.8-Max 等正式版模型。

## 四、Qwen 家族其他热门模型与适用场景

阿里云千问大模型是一个完整矩阵，除 Qwen4-Max 外，还有多款成熟模型可供选择：

模型 | 核心能力 | 适用场景 
---|---|---
Qwen3.8-Max | 2.4万亿参数 MoE 旗舰，1M 上下文 | 企业级核心业务、重度智能体、多模态复杂处理 
Qwen3.8-Flash | 轻量多模态，1M 上下文，输入0.8元/输出2.7元每百万token | 高并发智能体、轻量多模态、原型验证 
Qwen3.7-Max | 上代旗舰，纯文本能力 | 复杂文本推理、企业客服、知识库问答 
Qwen-Long | 1000万 Token 超长上下文 | 整本书籍、百万字合同解析 
Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro | 复杂图文一键生成 | 海报、信息图、跨境多语言物料 
Wan3.0-Video | 四模态全能参考，最长30秒成片 | 影视创作、广告营销、短视频 
Qwen3-Omni-Flash | 全模态理解与交互，60+语言 | 智能语音客服、实时翻译、车载助手 
Fun-ASR | 高精度实时语音转写 | 会议实时字幕、客服质检、直播字幕

## 六、便宜购买方法

想把成本压到最低，核心是两个动作：先领免费额度把效果验证清楚，再卡住订阅折扣把单价摊薄。

1、先免费试用，把额度用足。 完成实名认证、首次开通百炼服务的新用户，可免费领取超 7,000 万 Tokens。必须在百炼控制台完成服务开通并切换至华北 2（北京）地域，额度才会生效；有效期 90 天；仅限实时推理；建议开启"用完即停"防护。

2、选择使用 Token Plan 订阅方案。 Token Plan 把"单次调用多少钱"变成"一份固定月费能覆盖多少连续消耗"，费用可预算、用量可控制。超出部分还能用用量包（100 元/20,000 Credits）补充。

本次最值得关注的折扣组合：Qwen4-Max 预览版首发上线 Token Plan，Token Plan 新客首购低至 5 折；在此基础上，调用 Qwen4 限时 2 折，新用户再叠加 5 折，最低 1 折即可抢先体验 Qwen4。也就是说，一个从没买过 Token Plan 的新账号，可以先用 7,000 万免费 Tokens 验证效果，再以 19.5 元/月的价格订阅 Lite，用极低的成本把预览版跑起来。

Qwen4-Max 是千问第四代的旗舰模型，当前以预览版形态通过 Token Plan 首发。它的核心变化不在于参数规模的数字，而在于产品目标的转向：从"把问题回答好"转向"把任务完成好"。对使用者而言，理性的做法是：在预览期内用最低 1 折的成本，把自己手上最难的任务交给它跑一遍，记录 Credits 消耗、成功率与输出质量，形成属于自己业务场景的评估结论。

同时也要注意三点边界：预览版模型标识会在 2026 年 11 月 25 日 24:00 下线；模型调用折扣与订阅费是两笔账；模型调用折扣属于限时安排，到期后回归标准价。

# 2026年阿里云Qwen4-Max深度解析：定位、架构、能力与适用场景

2026-11-18 71

举报

简介： Qwen4-Max 是 2026年 Qwen4 系列的旗舰基座，2.4T 总参数、71B 激活、原生视觉、百万 Token 上下文，配合 GDN 与 QSA 混合注意力把长上下文的读取成本压了下来。它的价值不在单点分数，而在"能把长任务跑完并交付成品"这件事上，同时把单任务成本拉低了近六成。适用边界也很清楚：需要私有化部署或模型微调的项目，当前并不适用。选型时先看任务形态，再看成本结构，比只看榜单分数更有意义。

2026年11月，阿里云正式发布通义千问新一代旗舰基座模型 Qwen4-Max，并同步上线百炼平台。与前代旗舰相比，这一代的重点不再是单项能力刷榜，而是把优化方向压在专业工作场景的长链路任务上：更长的上下文、更少的 Token 消耗、更低的单任务成本，以及能持续交付可用成果的执行方式。本文从模型定位、架构特征、能力清单、评测表现、适用场景、接入方式六个层面做完整解析。文中数据取自官方模型卡与公开评测材料，具体规格以百炼模型页实时信息为准。

## 一、模型定位：从问答工具转向可交付工作的基座

Qwen4-Max 的官方定位是新一代旗舰多模态智能体基座模型。它的设计假设很明确：企业里真正有价值的工作，很少能塞进一次对话。这些任务往往持续数小时、跨越几十个工具、涉及上千页资料，最终必须产出一份团队能直接使用的东西——一份可运行的代码、一份可评审的方案、一张可交付的设计稿。详情👉访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面 了解。

因此它的能力取向围绕三件事展开：第一，能稳定调用专业工具链，而不只是生成文本；第二，能把长任务推进到终点，中途不丢上下文、不跑偏；第三，交付的是成品而非中间回答。官方把这套机制命名为 Live Delivery（渐进交付）：在长任务开始时先给出一版可用的初版，之后持续迭代提交改进版本，让团队在任务运行过程中就能评审和纠偏，而不是等到最后才发现方向错了。

这一定位决定了它与轻量对话模型的分工。日常问答、简单文案，用更小的模型成本更低；而跨文档分析、多文件工程改造、长流程智能体，才是 Qwen4-Max 的合理使用区间。

## 二、架构特征：2.4T 参数与百万上下文如何兼顾效率

Qwen4-Max 总参数规模为 2.4 万亿（2.4T），单 Token 仅激活 710 亿（71B），另外配置 3280 亿（328B）的 N-gram Embedding 参数。总参数大、激活参数小，是典型的稀疏混合专家路线，目的是在保住能力上限的同时压住单次推理的算力开销。官方数据显示，每个 Token 的激活参数比上一代减少约 25%。详情👉访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面 了解。

支撑百万级上下文的，是三项架构改动：

GDN + QSA 混合注意力。 每四层中，三层使用 Gated DeltaNet（GDN），把历史信息压缩成固定大小的状态，使 KV 缓存不随上下文长度线性增长；剩下一层使用 Qwen Sparse Attention（QSA），通过轻量索引定位关键段落。官方给出的效果是百万 Token 读取速度提升 7 倍以上。这一点对长文档、长代码库场景意义很大——上下文再长，显存与延迟也不会失控。

GR 门控残差。 把单通道残差流展宽为 4 条并行分支，配合动态读写门控，增强跨层信息传递。工程上的直接收益是 2.4T 规模训练全程平稳，没有出现损失突增（Loss Spike）。这类改动不出现在能力指标里，但决定了大模型能否稳定训到目标规模。

N-gram Embedding。 单独配置 328B 的 N-gram 嵌入参数，用于强化高频片段的表征，对代码、术语密集的专业文本有直接帮助。

规格层面，Qwen4-Max 上下文长度为 100 万 Token，最大输入 991,808 Token，最大输出 131,072 Token；开启思考模式时，最大输入 983,616 Token、最大输出 262,144 Token，最大思维链长度同为 262,144 Token。输入模态覆盖文本、图像、视频，输出为文本。原生视觉并非后期拼接的适配层，工程图纸、医疗影像、长视频都可以直接作为输入。

## 三、能力清单：哪些能做，哪些不做

官方模型卡列出的支持项包括：流式输出、深度思考、并行工具调用、联网搜索、前缀补全、Function Calling、思维链摘要与加密、结构化输出（JSON Object 与 JSON Schema）、显式缓存与隐式缓存、批量推理。接口层面兼容 OpenAI Chat Completions、Responses、Anthropic Messages 与 DashScope，迁移成本较低，已有 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 风格调用的项目大多只需换 Base URL 与模型 ID。

深度思考默认开启，可通过 reasoning_effort 调节推理力度。这里有一个必须注意的工程细节：从预览版开始，max_tokens 与 max_completion_tokens 语义等价，二者共同限制"思考内容 + 最终回答"的总量。如果沿用过去只为回答预留上限的写法，开启思考后输出会被提前截断。迁移时应当为思考与回答共同预留额度。

明确不支持的项同样重要：模型调优不支持，模型部署不支持。也就是说，Qwen4-Max 只能以 API 方式调用，不能私有化微调后自行部署。对数据必须留在自有环境的项目，这条限制需要在选型阶段就确认清楚。

## 四、评测表现：能力提升与成本下降同时发生

官方公布的 Work360 评测中，Qwen4-Max 得分 52.69，上一代为 47.74。在相同推理力度下，单任务 Token 消耗明显下降：Work360 在 Xhigh 与 High 两档分别减少约 24% 与 35%，Terminal-Bench 4.0 分别减少约 48% 与 49%。综合结果是平均单任务成本比上一代下降 58%。详情👉访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面 了解。

中文通用能力侧，2026年11月的 SuperCLUE 测评中 Qwen4-Max 取得 61.61 分，进入国内第一梯队，较上一版本提升 18.39 分。分项上，幻觉控制 73.61 分、提升 40.56 分；超长上下文 77.80 分、提升 33.42 分；智能体编程 57.69 分、提升 15.38 分。更值得关注的是稳定性：上一代在同一测试中超时率为 69.23%，新模型超时率降至 0%，全部试题跑完。按测试的 Token 开销与定价折算，平均每题成本约 1.90 元，较上一代下降约 87%。

这组数据的含义是：能力提升之外，单位任务的调用成本出现了数量级变化。对高频跑智能体流程的团队来说，成本项的变化往往比分数更能决定项目是否跑得起来。

## 五、适用场景：六类任务最匹配

编程开发与工程改造。 支持多文件读取、工具调用与结构化输出，配合百万上下文可直接把整个代码库放进一次会话。Terminal-Bench 上 Token 消耗下降近半，意味着批量重构、批量测试生成这类任务的账单压力明显减轻。

前端与设计还原。 原生视觉可直接读取设计稿、截图、原型图，输出可运行的页面代码，适合设计到开发的衔接环节。

办公与文档处理。 长报告、合同、财报、会议材料，单份即可覆盖在上下文内，不需要切块摘要再拼接，减少信息在切分过程中丢失的问题。结构化输出可以直接产出 JSON，方便对接下游系统。

复杂智能体与流程自动化。 并行工具调用、联网搜索、Function Calling 齐备，适合需要串联检索、计算、写文件、调用内部接口的长链路流程。Live Delivery 机制让长任务可以边跑边交付，便于中途校正。

专业视觉理解。 工程图纸、医疗影像、长视频分析，属于原生视觉的典型用例，无需额外接视觉模型。

长文档审阅与合规核查。 幻觉控制分项的大幅提升，加上长上下文能力，适合条款比对、事实核验这类对准确性敏感的工作。

反过来，不适合的场景也要说清：单轮简单问答、短文案润色、固定模板填表，用旗舰模型的成本没有必要；需要私有化部署或模型微调的项目，Qwen4-Max 目前不提供这两条路径。

## 六、接入与计费：Token Plan 是唯一入口

Qwen4-Max 通过百炼接入，预览版 qwen4-max-preview 仅支持 Token Plan，不开放按量计费。预览期为 2026年11月11日 10:00 至 11月25日 24:00（UTC+8），期间模型能力持续迭代，预览结束后下线，正式版 qwen4-max 已上线，建议直接使用正式版。

调用方式上，先开通 Token Plan 个人版或团队版，获取套餐专用 API Key（前缀 sk-sp），使用套餐专用 Base URL：
export DASHSCOPE_API_KEY="sk-sp-xxxxxxxx"
export BASE_URL="[https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com](https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com)"

          AI 代码解读

以 OpenAI 兼容方式发起一次带思考的调用：
curl "$BASE_URL/compatible-mode/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DASHSCOPE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "qwen4-max",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "分析这份接口文档的字段变更风险"}],
    "reasoning_effort": "high",
    "max_completion_tokens": 8192
  }'

          AI 代码解读

用 SDK 时同样只需替换模型与地址：
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="sk-sp-xxxxxxxx",
    base_url="[https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1](https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1)",
)
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="qwen4-max",
    messages=[{
   "role": "user", "content": "把这段 SQL 改写成可并行的版本"}],
    reasoning_effort="high",
    max_completion_tokens=8192,
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)

          AI 代码解读

计费侧需要记住三点：Token Plan 以 Credits 统一计量，一份订阅额度可覆盖平台内多款模型，套餐额度按月重置、不结转；套餐专用 Key 与通用 Key、其他订阅计划不通用；部署地域为华北2（北京），跨境业务需评估访问链路。

## 七、选型建议

判断是否需要 Qwen4-Max，可以先回答三个问题：任务是否需要跨几十页文档或整个代码库？是否需要在一次会话里连续调用多个工具直到产出成品？是否对事实准确性高度敏感？三项中命中两项以上，旗舰档才值得；否则更小的模型配外部工具组合，性价比通常更好。

对已经在用上一代旗舰的团队，迁移的收益主要落在两处：单任务 Token 消耗下降带来的账单缩减，以及超时率归零带来的流程稳定性。迁移风险集中在输出预算参数——务必按"思考 + 回答"合计的口径重新设定上限，否则会出现长任务被截断、看起来像模型能力不足的误判。

## 八、总结

Qwen4-Max 是 2026年 Qwen4 系列的旗舰基座，2.4T 总参数、71B 激活、原生视觉、百万 Token 上下文，配合 GDN 与 QSA 混合注意力把长上下文的读取成本压了下来。它的价值不在单点分数，而在"能把长任务跑完并交付成品"这件事上，同时把单任务成本拉低了近六成。适用边界也很清楚：需要私有化部署或模型微调的项目，当前并不适用。选型时先看任务形态，再看成本结构，比只看榜单分数更有意义。

深度思考默认开启，可通过 reasoning_effort 调节推理力度。这里有一个必须注意的工程细节：从预览版开始，max_tokens 与 max_completion_tokens 语义等价，二者共同限制"思考内容 + 最终回答"的总量。如果沿用过去只为回答预留上限的写法，开启思考后输出会被提前截断。迁移时应当为思考与回答共同预留额度。

明确不支持的项同样重要：模型调优不支持，模型部署不支持。也就是说，Qwen4-Max 只能以 API 方式调用，不能私有化微调后自行部署。对数据必须留在自有环境的项目，这条限制需要在选型阶段就确认清楚。

## 四、评测表现：能力提升与成本下降同时发生

官方公布的 Work360 评测中，Qwen4-Max 得分 52.69，上一代为 47.74。在相同推理力度下，单任务 Token 消耗明显下降：Work360 在 Xhigh 与 High 两档分别减少约 24% 与 35%，Terminal-Bench 4.0 分别减少约 48% 与 49%。综合结果是平均单任务成本比上一代下降 58%。详情👉访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面 了解。

中文通用能力侧，2026年11月的 SuperCLUE 测评中 Qwen4-Max 取得 61.61 分，进入国内第一梯队，较上一版本提升 18.39 分。分项上，幻觉控制 73.61 分、提升 40.56 分；超长上下文 77.80 分、提升 33.42 分；智能体编程 57.69 分、提升 15.38 分。更值得关注的是稳定性：上一代在同一测试中超时率为 69.23%，新模型超时率降至 0%，全部试题跑完。按测试的 Token 开销与定价折算，平均每题成本约 1.90 元，较上一代下降约 87%。

这组数据的含义是：能力提升之外，单位任务的调用成本出现了数量级变化。对高频跑智能体流程的团队来说，成本项的变化往往比分数更能决定项目是否跑得起来。

## 五、适用场景：六类任务最匹配

编程开发与工程改造。 支持多文件读取、工具调用与结构化输出，配合百万上下文可直接把整个代码库放进一次会话。Terminal-Bench 上 Token 消耗下降近半，意味着批量重构、批量测试生成这类任务的账单压力明显减轻。

前端与设计还原。 原生视觉可直接读取设计稿、截图、原型图，输出可运行的页面代码，适合设计到开发的衔接环节。

办公与文档处理。 长报告、合同、财报、会议材料，单份即可覆盖在上下文内，不需要切块摘要再拼接，减少信息在切分过程中丢失的问题。结构化输出可以直接产出 JSON，方便对接下游系统。

复杂智能体与流程自动化。 并行工具调用、联网搜索、Function Calling 齐备，适合需要串联检索、计算、写文件、调用内部接口的长链路流程。Live Delivery 机制让长任务可以边跑边交付，便于中途校正。

专业视觉理解。 工程图纸、医疗影像、长视频分析，属于原生视觉的典型用例，无需额外接视觉模型。

长文档审阅与合规核查。 幻觉控制分项的大幅提升，加上长上下文能力，适合条款比对、事实核验这类对准确性敏感的工作。

反过来，不适合的场景也要说清：单轮简单问答、短文案润色、固定模板填表，用旗舰模型的成本没有必要；需要私有化部署或模型微调的项目，Qwen4-Max 目前不提供这两条路径。

## 六、接入与计费：Token Plan 是唯一入口

Qwen4-Max 通过百炼接入，预览版 qwen4-max-preview 仅支持 Token Plan，不开放按量计费。预览期为 2026年11月11日 10:00 至 11月25日 24:00（UTC+8），期间模型能力持续迭代，预览结束后下线，正式版 qwen4-max 已上线，建议直接使用正式版。

调用方式上，先开通 Token Plan 个人版或团队版，获取套餐专用 API Key（前缀 sk-sp），使用套餐专用 Base URL：
export DASHSCOPE_API_KEY="sk-sp-xxxxxxxx"
export BASE_URL="[https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com](https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com)"

          AI 代码解读

以 OpenAI 兼容方式发起一次带思考的调用：
curl "$BASE_URL/compatible-mode/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DASHSCOPE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "qwen4-max",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "分析这份接口文档的字段变更风险"}],
    "reasoning_effort": "high",
    "max_completion_tokens": 8192
  }'

          AI 代码解读

用 SDK 时同样只需替换模型与地址：
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="sk-sp-xxxxxxxx",
    base_url="[https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1](https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1)",
)
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="qwen4-max",
    messages=[{
   "role": "user", "content": "把这段 SQL 改写成可并行的版本"}],
    reasoning_effort="high",
    max_completion_tokens=8192,
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)

          AI 代码解读

计费侧需要记住三点：Token Plan 以 Credits 统一计量，一份订阅额度可覆盖平台内多款模型，套餐额度按月重置、不结转；套餐专用 Key 与通用 Key、其他订阅计划不通用；部署地域为华北2（北京），跨境业务需评估访问链路。

## 七、选型建议

判断是否需要 Qwen4-Max，可以先回答三个问题：任务是否需要跨几十页文档或整个代码库？是否需要在一次会话里连续调用多个工具直到产出成品？是否对事实准确性高度敏感？三项中命中两项以上，旗舰档才值得；否则更小的模型配外部工具组合，性价比通常更好。对已经在用上一代旗舰的团队，迁移的收益主要落在两处：单任务 Token 消耗下降带来的账单缩减，以及超时率归零带来的流程稳定性。迁移风险集中在输出预算参数——务必按"思考 + 回答"合计的口径重新设定上限，否则会出现长任务被截断、看起来像模型能力不足的误判。

## 八、总结

Qwen4-Max 是 2026年 Qwen4 系列的旗舰基座，2.4T 总参数、71B 激活、原生视觉、百万 Token 上下文，配合 GDN 与 QSA 混合注意力把长上下文的读取成本压了下来。它的价值不在单点分数，而在"能把长任务跑完并交付成品"这件事上，同时把单任务成本拉低了近六成。适用边界也很清楚：需要私有化部署或模型微调的项目，当前并不适用。选型时先看任务形态，再看成本结构，比只看榜单分数更有意义。

Qwen.title: Model releases and updates - Alibaba Cloud - qwen3-max-preview
Qwen.description: The Tongyi Qianwen QVQ visual reasoning model supports visual input and chain-of-thought output ... The general text vectorization model is a multilingual unified text vectorization model developed by Tongyi Lab based on the large language model (LLM) foundation.
Qwen.content:
#### qwen3-max-preview

A preview version of the Max model in the Qwen 3 series, achieving an effective integration of thinking and non-thinking modes. In thinking mode, there is a significant enhancement in capabilities such as intelligent agent programming, common-sense reasoning, and reasoning across mathematics, science, and general domains.

#### text-embedding-v4

The General Text Vector V4 version is a multi-language text vector model developed by the Tongyi Lab based on Qwen3. Compared to the V3 version, it significantly improves performance in text retrieval, clustering, and classification tasks. It achieves a 15% to 40% improvement in evaluation tasks such as MTEB multilingual, Chinese-English, and code retrieval. Additionally, it supports user-defined vector dimensions ranging from 64 to 2048.

#### qwen-image-edit

The first Qwen image editing model extends Qwen-Image's text rendering to editing tasks. It offers precise bilingual (Chinese/English) text editing, dual visual and semantic editing, and strong cross-benchmark performance.

#### wan2.2-i2v-flash

The upgraded Wan 2.2 image to video Flash model, delivers faster speed with optimized stability, more powerful prompt following, improved consistency for text, portraits, and products, and precise shot control.

#### qwen-omni-turbo-realtime

#### qwen-omni-turbo-realtime-latest

#### qwen-omni-turbo-realtime-2025-05-08

The real-time version of Qwen's new large multimodal understanding and generation model, suitable for real-time audio interaction scenarios. It supports the understanding of audio accompanied by text, images, and video mixed inputs, and can simultaneously generate speech and text in stream, providing four natural tones.

#### qwen-image

The first image generation foundation model in the Qwen series that achieves significant advances in complex text rendering and precise image editing. Experiments show strong general capabilities in both image generation and editing, with exceptional performance in text rendering, especially for Chinese.

#### qwen-flash

#### qwen-flash-2025-07-28

The Qwen3 Flash model offers a powerful fusion of thinking and non-thinking modes with dynamic in-conversation switching, excelling in complex reasoning while showing significant gains in instruction following and text comprehension. It supports a 1M context length and is billed on a tiered model corresponding to context usage.

#### qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct

Qwen3-based code generation model that inherits the coding agent ability of Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct; code capability reaches SOTA at the same scale.

#### qwen-plus-latest

The Qwen series model optimized for balanced performance, offering inference efficiency between Qwen-Max and Qwen-Turbo, is designed to handle moderately complex tasks effectively. This dynamically updated version implements changes without prior notice.

#### qwen3-30b-a3b-thinking-2507

Open-source Qwen3 thinking model; compared to the previous version (Qwen3-30B-A3B) excels in complex thinking tasks, including logic, math, science, code, and other challenging scenarios; instruction following, text understanding, and multilingual translation capabilities significantly improved.

#### qwen3-coder-flash

#### qwen3-coder-flash-2025-07-28

Based on Qwen3, this code generation model inherits the coding agent capabilities of Qwen3-Coder-Plus and supports multi-turn tool interaction. It features focused optimizations on repository-level understanding and enhanced tool-calling stability.

#### qwen3-30b-a3b-instruct-2507

Open-source Qwen3 non-thinking model; compared to the previous version (Qwen3-30B-A3B) shows major improvements in Chinese, English, and overall multilingual general capabilities. Optimized for subjective open-ended tasks, delivering responses significantly more aligned with user preferences and more helpful.

#### qwen-plus-2025-07-28

Qwen3 series Plus model, integrates thinking and non-thinking modes and can switch modes during dialogue. Compared to the prior version, adds dedicated enhancements for Chinese & English capabilities and tool calling. This is a snapshot from 28 July, 2025; first to support 1 M context length, and uses tiered pricing.

#### wan2.2-t2v-plus

The upgraded Wan 2.2 Plus text to video model, delivers higher quality results with stable sweeping complex movements, cinematic vision control, more powerful prompt following, and realistic world recreation.

#### wan2.2-t2i-plus

The upgraded Wan 2.2 Plus text to image model, delivers richer image detail with enhanced creativity, stability, and realism. It also features stronger prompt following and native support for multiple styles. Up to 2 million pixel generation and prompt enhancement are supported as well.

#### wan2.2-t2i-flash

The upgraded Wan 2.2 Flash text to image model, delivers faster speed with enhanced creativity, stability, and realism. It also features stronger prompt following and native support for multiple styles. Up to 2 million pixel generation and prompt enhancement are supported as well.

#### wan2.2-i2v-plus

The upgraded Wan 2.2 Plus image to video model, delivers higher quality results with optimized stability, more powerful prompt following, improved consistency for text, portraits, and products, and precise shot control.

#### qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507

Open-source Qwen3 thinking model; compared to the previous version (Qwen3-235B-A22B) shows major improvements in logical ability, general capabilities, knowledge enhancement, and creativity, suitable for high-difficulty, strong-thinking scenarios.

#### qwen-mt-turbo

Qwen-MT-Turbo is a large language model within the Qwen model series that specializes in multi-lingual translation. It provides high-quality and rapid translation services across 92 languages at a cost-effective price point. It also offers features such as terminology intervention, format preservation, and domain-specific translation to cater to the diverse needs of various applications, ensuring both efficiency and performance.

#### qwen-mt-plus

Qwen-MT-Plus, the flagship translation model from our Qwen series, is now fully upgraded with the Qwen3 architecture. It supports 92 languages and delivers exceptionally accurate and natural-sounding translations. Its advanced capabilities in contextual understanding, terminology control, and format preservation make it a superior choice over traditional models, especially for specialized domains.

#### qwen3-coder-plus

#### qwen3-coder-plus-2025-07-22

Qwen3-based code generation model with strong coding agent power, excels at tool calling and environment interaction, capable of autonomous programming with outstanding code capability while maintaining general ability.

#### qwen3-coder-480b-a35b-instruct

Qwen3-based code generation model with strong coding agent power; code capability reaches open-source SOTA.

#### qwen3-235b-a22b-instruct-2507

Open-source Qwen3 non-thinking model; compared to the previous version (Qwen3-235B-A22B) shows slight improvements in subjective creativity and model safety.

#### qwen-plus-2025-07-14

The Plus model of the Qwen3 Series, achieving effective integration of thinking mode and non-thinking mode, allows switching modes during conversations. This is a snapshot from July 14, 2025. Compared to the previous version, there has been a significant improvement in both Chinese and English capabilities under non-thinking mode, with enhanced tool-calling abilities.

#### qwen-plus-character-ja

The Qwen Role-Playing Model Series is specifically optimized for Japanese anthropomorphic interaction scenarios. It demonstrates advanced capabilities in character consistency maintenance, context-aware dialogue progression, and empathetic engagement, enabling precise personalized character embodiment. This version significantly enhances Japanese linguistic localization (including dialects and honorifics), human-like role-playing authenticity, narrative coherence control, and scenario-based cognitive intelligence.

#### qwen-omni-turbo

#### qwen-omni-turbo-latest

#### qwen-omni-turbo-2025-03-26

The new multimodal understanding and generation model, supporting text, image, speech, and video input as well as mixed input understanding. It can simultaneously stream text and speech, with significantly enhanced speed for multimodal content understanding. Additionally, it offers four natural dialogue tones.

#### wan2.1-t2i-turbo

Wan2.1 Text-to-Image Turbo version, faster generation speed. Upgraded in image beauty, realism, and artistry. Stronger semantic understanding ability, rich style generalization ability, supports up to 2 million pixel generation, supports smart prompt rewriting.

#### wan2.1-t2i-plus

Wan2.1 Text-to-Image Plus version, Generate more image details. Upgraded in image beauty, realism, and artistry. Stronger semantic understanding ability, rich style generalization ability, supports up to 2 million pixel generation, supports smart prompt rewriting.

#### wan2.1-vace-plus

Wan2.1-VACE-Plus All-in-One Video Creation and Editing model.It supports local editing, video repainting, background outpainting, duration extension, image reference, and other video editing and generation tasks, and supports multimodal conditional control through text, images, and videos.

#### qwen3-8b

Achieves effective integration of thinking and non-thinking modes, allowing mode switching during conversations. Its reasoning capability reaches the SOTA level in the same scale industry, and its general capability significantly surpasses Qwen2.5-7B.

#### qwen3-32b

Achieves effective integration of thinking and non-thinking modes, allowing mode switching during conversations. Its reasoning capability significantly surpasses QwQ, and its general capability markedly exceeds Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, reaching the SOTA level in the same scale industry.

GLM.content:
# GLM-5.3

Source: https://docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-5.3

[!TIP]

GLM-5.3 is now available to all GLM Coding Plan users, with 50% better coding performance! Subscribe now

## Overview

GLM-5.3 is Z.ai's latest flagship model, delivering comprehensive advancements in complex software engineering and agent capabilities. It uses the same base model as GLM-5.2, with all improvements driven by post-training. Compared with GLM-5.2, it delivers significantly stronger performance in complex programming and long-horizon tasks:

Stronger Coding Capability

GLM-5.3 delivers a significant improvement in coding capabilities, achieving a 50% performance gain over GLM-5.2 on Z.ai Code Bench. It also reaches state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance among open-source models on public benchmarks, including Terminal Bench 3.0 and Agents’ Last Exam (CLI).

Emergent Cyber Capability

As the scale of post-training continues to expand, the model’s cybersecurity capabilities have improved at a rate that exceeds expectations. GLM-5.3 achieves the best performance to date on the CyberGym vulnerability discovery benchmark. Moreover, the deeper it progresses along the vulnerability exploitation chain, the more pronounced its gains over GLM-5.2 become, with scores on vulnerability exploitation benchmarks exceeding twice those of GLM-5.2.

↗ Blog

## Feature Changes

GLM-5.3 currently supports text-only inputs, with a 1M-token context window and a maximum output length of 128K tokens. GLM-5.3 always operates with reasoning enabled and supports three reasoning effort levels:low, high, and max. Disabling reasoning is no longer supported. The reasoning parameters are described below:

Parameter | Values | Default | Description 
---|---|---|---
thinking.type | enabled | enabled | Supports reasoning only; disabling reasoning is not supported. 
reasoning_effort | low, high, max | max | low – Lightweight Reasoning; high – Enhanced Reasoning; max – Deep Reasoning 

[!NOTE]

Migration Notice: If your application currently uses
thinking.type: "disabled", please change it to enabled and set reasoning_effort to low before updating the model ID to glm-5.3. Otherwise, the request will fail.
For complex tasks such as coding, we recommend usingmax. An example is provided below:
{
  "model": "glm-5.3",
  "thinking": { "type": "enabled" },
  "reasoning_effort": "max"
}

For a detailed introduction to GLM-5.3’s advanced reasoning capabilities, please refer to the documentation: Deep Thinking

## How to Use

#### Model API

The supported protocols and endpoints are as follows:

Protocol | Base URL 
---|---
OpenAI Chat Completion Protocol | 	https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4 
OpenAI Response Protocol | 	https://api.z.ai/api/v1 
Anthropic Message Protocol | https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic 

↗ API Documentation：Learn how to call the API

[!NOTE]

If you have previously subscribed to a GLM Coding Plan, including an expired subscription, you can currently access the model API only through the OpenAI Chat Completion-compatible protocol. We will continue to improve and optimize this in upcoming iterations.

#### GLM Coding Plan

GLM-5.3 is now fully available, and you can use it with your preferred coding agents. Guide

The new GLM Coding Plan adopts a points-based quota system, providing transparent and predictable usage. Model calls made during off-peak hours, including all day on weekends, consume only 50% of the standard points. Subscribe now: Individual Plan、Team Plan.

## Capability Support

- Thinking Mode：Provides multiple thinking modes to accommodate different task requirements
- Streaming Messages：Supports real-time streaming responses for an enhanced user interaction experience
- Function Calling：Provides powerful tool-calling capabilities and supports integration with a wide range of external tools
- Context Caching：Uses an intelligent caching mechanism to optimize performance in long-context conversations
- Structured Output：Supports structured output formats such as JSON for seamless system integration

## Key Advancements

GLM-5.3 delivers significant improvements across complex software engineering, terminal operations, and a broader range of real-world Agent tasks.

#### Stronger Coding

For GLM-5.3, we pushed environment scaling toward tasks that look less like coding exercises and more like real units of expert work. The environments now cover a much broader range of production workflows, with tasks designed around how engineering and research work is actually carried out in practice. Some represent several days of work for an experienced engineer.

In an ML infrastructure task, for example, the model may be given the same working environment as an engineer, with access to compute clusters, storage systems, internal documentation, codebases, and experiment results. It must diagnose bottlenecks across the training stack, implement optimizations, run experiments, and deliver a measurable end-to-end speedup while preserving correctness. Training on environments at this level pushes the model toward taking ownership of substantial work end to end, rather than relying on users to decompose the problem and supervise each step.

As agent capability improves, much of the difficulty in scaling post-training moves from the model to the environment. A useful task environment has to be executable, verifiable, and close to real professional work — and we need many of them, not a handful of hand-built ones. To scale this process, we built pipelines that synthesize environments end to end, and for a subset of tasks, the RL reward signal as well. Research agents collect task patterns from real work and turn them into runnable long-horizon environments with multi-step dependencies and hidden state; a judge agent then attempts each task to verify that it is actually solvable. Verifiers are synthesized without access to the reference solution, while solver trajectories are used to discover and close reward shortcuts. A verifier that passes oracle, no-op, and unsolved-state checks produces a binary reward reliable enough to train on directly.

It carries over the RL strategies introduced in GLM-5.2, including SAO with compaction, which helps these gains hold on long-horizon tasks rather than only on short ones. The effect shows up across both coding and general agent tasks. GLM-5.3 improves from 4.6 to 28.3 on Terminal-Bench 3.0, from 46.2 to 66.9 on DeepSWE v1.1, and from 23.8 to 28.5 on Agents' Last Exam. These pipelines still require a meaningful amount of human-in-the-loop work; making environment generation and verification more autonomous is one of the next steps.

Beyond public benchmarks, we introduce Z.ai Code Bench, an in-house benchmark designed to evaluate coding agents under realistic user scenarios. It covers diverse task categories and places agents in complex local development environments. At different effort levels, we evaluate agents along two dimensions: end-to-end task completion rate and fine-grained checklist accuracy. As a private benchmark, Z.ai Code Bench also reduces the risk of contamination from public test sets and gives us a more faithful measure of real-world user experience.

As shown in the figure, GLM-5.3 improves both performance and token efficiency. It delivers markedly stronger agentic coding results than GLM-5.2 at every effort level while consuming fewer output tokens. At Max effort, GLM-5.3 reaches 34.5% at roughly 75K output tokens per task, compared with 23.4% at 96K for GLM-5.2. The same shift holds against closed models. At High effort, GLM-5.3 reaches 31.4% at around 50K output tokens, surpassing Claude Opus 4.8 at 29.5% with 120K. GLM-5.3 remains behind Claude Fable 5, which reaches 39.5% at Max effort.

#### Emergent Cyber Capability

As part of post-training, we introduced vulnerability discovery data and environments into the training mix. We expected this to make the model better at finding and reasoning about vulnerabilities. What surprised us was how quickly the capability continued to develop as training scaled. GLM-5.3 did not simply become better at identifying isolated flaws: it began to reason across multiple stages of exploitation, forming coherent plans for complete exploitation chains.

We evaluate GLM-5.3 across three benchmarks covering different stages of vulnerability analysis and exploitation.

We evaluate GLM-5.3 across three benchmarks covering different stages of vulnerability analysis and exploitation. On CyberGym, which starts from white-box source code and tests whether the model can identify and validate vulnerabilities by triggering faults, GLM-5.3 scores 84.5%, up from GLM-5.2's 77.2% — the best result on the benchmark, ahead of Mythos 5 (83.8%) and GPT-5.6 Sol (83.6%). On ExploitBench, which requires deeper reasoning about real vulnerabilities and their exploitation, GLM-5.3 reaches 54.4%, more than doubling GLM-5.2's 24.4%, while Mythos 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol score 78.0% and 76.5%, respectively. On ExploitGym, which measures how many exploitation tasks a model can complete under time-normalized budgets, GLM-5.3 completes 105 tasks within two hours and 130 within six hours, compared with 29 and 39 for GLM-5.2; budgets are normalized across models using per-model throughput figures, detailed in the footnotes. Mythos 5 remains well ahead at 181 and 247 tasks.

The pattern across the three is consistent: the further up the exploitation chain a benchmark sits, the larger the gain from GLM-5.2 — and also the wider the remaining gap to the closed frontier. Capability is growing fastest exactly where we are furthest behind.

We then tested whether these capabilities transfer beyond controlled benchmarks. Since GLM-5.2, we have been working with several security teams in China to run our models against real-world codebases. GLM.title: Use Z.ai with the AI Gateway
GLM.description: Z.ai, formerly Zhipu AI, builds the open-weight GLM family of models for agents, reasoning, and coding. ... QwenCloud, Tencent TokenHub, and Mistral AI also serve GLM models, so the `z-ai:` prefix keeps the request on Z.ai.
GLM.content:
# Use Z.ai with the AI Gateway

Z.ai, formerly Zhipu AI, builds the open-weight GLM family of models for agents, reasoning, and coding.

Z.ai supports Chat Completions requests.

Z.ai is a built-in provider you can pay for with credits, so a provider key is optional. Add your own Z.ai key to bill usage to your Z.ai account instead of your ngrok.ai credits.

## Setup

### Create an access key and add credits
Follow the [quickstart](/ai-gateway/quickstart) to create an access key and purchase [credits](/ai-gateway/concepts/credits) in [app.ngrok.ai](https://app.ngrok.ai).

### Store your Z.ai API key (optional)
Skip this step to pay with credits.
To bring your own key, create an API key in your [Z.ai](https://z.ai/model-api) account. Then [add a provider key](/ai-gateway/guides/attaching-provider-keys#add-a-provider-key) and [create an access key configuration](/ai-gateway/guides/access-key-configurations#create-a-configuration) with a `z-ai` routing rule that uses it.

### Send requests
Send requests with your access key:

```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="https://gateway.ngrok.ai/v1",
    api_key="ng-xxxxx-g1-xxxxx",
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="z-ai:glm-5.3",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
```

QwenCloud, Tencent TokenHub, and Mistral AI also serve GLM models, so the `z-ai:` prefix keeps the request on Z.ai.

## Available models

See the model catalog.

GLM.content:
# Z.AI Coding Plan (Zhipu AI)

The Z.AI Coding Plan is a monthly subscription from Zhipu AI that gives you access to GLM models through an OpenAI-compatible API. GLM models are strong at text generation, deep thinking, and code — and the coding plan provides flat-rate access for use with AI coding tools.

## Why Z.AI?

- GLM model family — Access to GLM-5, GLM-4.7, and other variants
- OpenAI-compatible — Works with any tool that supports the OpenAI Chat Completions API
- International endpoint — Global access viaapi.z.ai
- Coding-optimized — Subscription designed for coding tool integration

## Available Models

Model | Capabilities 
---|---
glm-5 | Text generation, deep thinking 
glm-4.7 | Text generation, deep thinking 
glm-4.7-flash | Fast text generation 
glm-4.7-flashx | Fast text generation 
glm-4.6 | Text generation 
glm-4.6v | Text generation, visual understanding 
glm-4.5 | Text generation 
glm-4.5-air | Lightweight text generation 
glm-4.5-flash | Fast text generation 
glm-4.5v | Text generation, visual understanding 

::: tip Model Selection For general use, start withglm-5 — it's the most capable model. For faster responses, try glm-4.7-flash. Models ending in v support visual understanding (image input).
:::

## Quick Setup

### Step 1: Get Your API Key

- Go to Z.AI and sign in
- Navigate to your API key management page
- Create a new API key
- Copy the key (format:hexstring.Base64string)

### Step 2: Configure in Crow's Nest

- Open your Crow's Nest → Settings
- Find the AI Provider section
- Set:
- Provider: OpenAI (Z.AI uses an OpenAI-compatible API)
- API Key: Your Z.AI key
- Model:glm-5 (or any model from the table above)
- Base URL:https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4

- Click Save, then Test Connection
- Go to Messages → the AI Chat tab is now active

### Alternative:.env Configuration
AI_PROVIDER=openai
AI_API_KEY=your-zai-key-here
AI_MODEL=glm-5
AI_BASE_URL=https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4

No gateway restart needed — the config is hot-reloaded.

## Switching Models

To switch models, updateAI_MODEL in Settings or .env to any model from the table above. All models use the same API key and base URL — only the model name changes.

## Endpoint Reference

Purpose | URL 
---|---
Coding Plan (international) | https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4 
Standard API (international) | https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4 
Standard API (China mainland) | https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4 

::: warning The Coding Plan endpoint (/api/coding/paas/v4) is different from the standard API endpoint (/api/paas/v4). Use the correct one for your subscription type.
:::

## Troubleshooting

### "API key is invalid (401)"

Make sure you're using a Coding Plan key with the Coding Plan endpoint. Standard API keys don't work with the Coding Plan endpoint and vice versa.

### "Model not found (404)"

Check the model name matches exactly (case-sensitive). The available models depend on your subscription tier.

### Tool calls not working

GLM models generally support function/tool calling. If tools aren't working, tryglm-5 which has the strongest tool calling support.
